title: Product Owner - Sênior
description:
Product Owner - Sênior

A jornada de quem ama repensar o futuro está aqui.


Sobre a Rethink

Somos uma consultoria que une tecnologia, design e estratégia de produtos digitais para solucionar os desafios de grandes empresas brasileiras. Agora como parte da Framework Digital , ampliamos nosso impacto atuando de ponta a ponta na jornada digital, da concepção à escala.


Nossa missão é gerar valor real por meio de soluções que conectam times, sistemas e pessoas. Acreditamos que a transformação digital acontece quando estratégia, tecnologia e experiência andam juntas e é isso que entregamos.


Empresas como Smiles, Gol, Santander Esfera, Swift e Comgás confiam em nossa parceria para acelerar sua evolução digital com consistência e resultado.

Diversidade e Inclusão

Para repensar o futuro, é essencial garantir ambientes mais diversos e inclusivos . Por isso, incentivamos fortemente a candidatura de mulheres, pessoas pretas, pardas, indígenas, LGBTQIAPN+ e pessoas com deficiência .

Que tal repensar um futuro mais diverso com a gente?

Qual será o seu papel?

No seu dia a dia, você gerenciará o backlog do produto, priorizando funcionalidades com base no valor para o negócio, impacto operacional e necessidades regulatórias. Atuará como principal interlocutor entre as áreas de negócio (operações, comercial, regulatório, supply chain) e os times de desenvolvimento, traduzindo necessidades de negócio em requisitos técnicos claros e viáveis. Você liderará cerimônias ágeis e garantirá a entrega contínua de valor, promovendo melhorias incrementais nos processos de distribuição de gás. Além disso, acompanhará métricas de desempenho do produto (KPIs de negócio e de uso), proporá evoluções baseadas em dados e feedback dos usuários, e garantirá que as soluções desenvolvidas estejam em conformidade com as normas de segurança e regulação do setor de gás.


Como será seu dia a dia?

  • Gerenciar o backlog do produto, priorizando funcionalidades com base no valor para o negócio, impacto operacional e necessidades regulatórias.
  • Atuar como principal interlocutor(a) entre áreas de negócio (operações, comercial, regulatório e supply chain) e os times de desenvolvimento, traduzindo necessidades em requisitos técnicos claros e viáveis.
  • Liderar cerimônias ágeis e garantir a entrega contínua de valor para o produto.
  • Promover melhorias incrementais nos processos de distribuição de gás.
  • Acompanhar métricas de desempenho (KPIs de negócio e de uso), analisando dados para direcionar evoluções do produto.
  • Propor melhorias com base em dados e feedbacks dos usuários.
  • Garantir que as soluções estejam em conformidade com normas de segurança e regulação do setor.


Para esta vaga, é essencial:

  • Visão holística e estratégica, com capacidade de compreender o negócio de distribuição de gás de ponta a ponta, conectando iniciativas de tecnologia às metas do negócio.
  • Perfil de liderança com forte viés de execução, sendo “mão na massa”, orientado(a) a resultados e capaz de remover impedimentos para garantir entregas com qualidade e agilidade.
  • Excelente comunicação e habilidade de transitar entre áreas, atuando como ponte entre negócio e tecnologia.
  • Sólido conhecimento em metodologias ágeis (Scrum, Kanban, SAFe) e práticas de gestão de produto (roadmaps, OKRs, MVPs).
  • Experiência na liderança de squads multidisciplinares e atuação em ciclos de discovery e delivery.
  • Formação superior em Administração, Engenharia, Ciência da Computação ou áreas correlatas.


Você pode se destacar se:

  • Possuir pós-graduação ou MBA em Gestão de Negócios, Energia ou Transformação Digital.
  • Tiver certificações em Product Ownership (CSPO, PSPO) e metodologias ágeis (CSM, SAFe).
  • Tiver familiaridade com o setor de gás e energia, incluindo regulação da ANP e processos como medição, faturamento, logística e segurança operacional.
  • Demonstrar forte visão sistêmica e pensamento crítico.
  • Apresentar habilidade de negociação e influência.
  • Ser resiliente e adaptável em ambientes de alta complexidade.
  • Ter perfil colaborativo e facilitador.
  • Demonstrar orientação a resultados e senso de urgência.
  • Possuir experiência em contextos dinâmicos.

Curtiu a oportunidade?

Então, vem repensar o futuro com a gente! ✨

title: Forensic Manager
description:
This leading multinational group, with significant operations across the Americas and worldwide, is seeking an experienced Forensic Manager to lead a team of corporate investigators across their regional operations.


Based in Belo Horizonte, you will be responsible for managing a team of forensic specialists who are overseeing investigations into complex financial crimes, including conflict-of-interest, procurement fraud, misappropriation of assets, corruption, and bribery.


Your role will be primarily focused on team leadership, setting key performance objectives, and building strategic relationships to ensure seamless regional operations. You will have day-to-day responsibility for managing forensic specialists, providing career development guidance, and overseeing resource allocation. Furthermore, you will serve as the primary point of contact for operational management while playing a key role in the overall strategic management of the group’s investigative objectives.


In addition to your leadership duties, you will undertake high-level corporate investigation projects, conduct fraud awareness training, and oversee the integration of data analytics into investigative workflows.


To be successful in this role, you should possess extensive experience in leading complex corporate investigations and managing specialized forensic teams. You are likely currently working in a managerial capacity within a forensic advisory firm or a comparable corporate business.


While a CFE qualification is highly welcomed, we value your proven ability to lead high-performance teams and manage senior stakeholder relationships. Excellent communication skills are essential, and candidates must be fluent in both Portuguese and English. Proficiency in Spanish and experience with advanced data analytics tools are welcomed.


For more information, please see our video

title: Senior DevOps Engineer (Kubernetes & Cloud Infrastructure) PJ
description:
Qual será o seu papel?

  • Administração de Ambientes Híbridos: Gerenciar e implantar clusters Kubernetes tanto em ambientes On-Premises (usando kubeadm) quanto em nuvens públicas.
  • Gestão de Infraestrutura como Código (IaC): Provisionar e manter recursos de infraestrutura utilizando Terraform e Ansible, garantindo a escalabilidade do ambiente.
  • Otimização e Segurança de Containers: Criar e otimizar imagens Docker, além de gerenciar políticas de segurança, RBAC, quotas e namespaces no ecossistema Kubernetes.
  • Sustentação e Troubleshooting: Diagnosticar e resolver problemas complexos em pods, nós e serviços, utilizando ferramentas nativas e CLI de nuvem.
  • Monitoramento e Observabilidade: Implementar e analisar métricas e logs para garantir a saúde dos clusters e identificar gargalos de performance (CPU, memória, IOPS) de forma proativa.


Esperamos que você tenha:

  • Domínio de Kubernetes: Experiência avançada em configuração de redes (CNI/Cilium), serviços (LoadBalancer, Ingress) e Service Mesh (Istio).
  • Experiência com Armazenamento: Sólido conhecimento em PVs, PVCs e provisionadores de storage (Ceph, NFS ou nativos de nuvem como EBS/Azure Disk).
  • Fluência em Automação e CI/CD: Experiência prática na construção de pipelines e integração de automações com GitLab CI/CD e ArgoCD.
  • Conhecimento em Observabilidade: Experiência técnica com a stack Prometheus, Grafana e Alertmanager, além de gestão de logs (Fluentd, Loki, Elasticsearch).
  • Habilidade com IaC e Helm: Proficiência em Terraform, Ansible e no empacotamento/deploy de aplicações via Helm Charts.


Vamos ficar felizes se você tiver (seu diferencial):

  • Multicloud: Vivência em múltiplos provedores de nuvem (GCP, OCI, AWS, Azure).
  • Foco em Segurança: Experiência avançada na implementação de políticas de segurança de rede e endurecimento (hardening) de imagens Docker.
  • Mentalidade Proativa: Capacidade comprovada de antecipar incidentes graves através da análise técnica de recursos de infraestrutura.
  • Certificações nos provedores de Cloud (OCI, AWS, GCP, Azure)


Contratação: PJ.

title: Solutions Architect – Data Services
description:
Job Title: Solutions Architect – Data Services

Position Type: Full-Time Contract (40hrs/week)

Contract Duration: Through December 2026 (Possibility of Extension)

Work Schedule: 8 hours/day (Mon-Fri)

Work Hours: EST

Location: 100% Remote - (Candidates can work from anywhere in LATAM Countries)


Role Overview

We are seeking an experienced Solutions Architect – Data Services to lead the design and delivery of enterprise-scale data solutions for a global consulting environment. This role is responsible for defining end-to-end architectures across modern data platforms, ensuring alignment with business objectives, governance standards, and enterprise architecture principles.


The ideal candidate brings deep expertise in Azure Databricks , data engineering, and cloud-native architectures, along with hands-on experience in data mesh , data products , and Unity Catalog–based governance . This is a hands-on architect role , requiring both strategic thinking and practical execution through proof-of-concepts (POCs) and close collaboration with engineering teams.


Key Responsibilities


Solution & Data Architecture

  • Define and own solution-level architectures across data platforms, with a focus on Azure Databricks (workspaces, compute, orchestration).
  • Design and implement data mesh architectures and domain-oriented data products.
  • Establish governance frameworks using Unity Catalog , including security, lineage, and multi-workspace strategies.
  • Translate business requirements into scalable, secure, and production-ready data solutions.
  • Identify cross-system dependencies, integration points, and architectural risks.


Data Platform Design & Governance

  • Define best practices for data ingestion, transformation, and serving within Databricks.
  • Establish standards for data product ownership, contracts, and lifecycle management.
  • Implement enterprise-grade security and access control using Unity Catalog, Entra ID, and cloud-native tools.
  • Ensure alignment with enterprise governance, compliance, and security policies.
  • Contribute to reusable architecture patterns and platform standards.


Hands-on Execution & Proof-of-Concepts

  • Design and execute POCs to validate architectural decisions and reduce delivery risk.
  • Remain hands-on with:
  • Python for data engineering, notebooks, and automation
  • C# / Python for APIs, integrations, and platform services
  • Support engineering teams by reviewing designs, resolving technical challenges, and ensuring architectural alignment.


Collaboration & Delivery Alignment

  • Partner with Product Management and business stakeholders to shape features and solution direction.
  • Collaborate with System Architects to align solution and system-level designs.
  • Guide Agile teams through architecture decisions during planning and execution.
  • Participate in architecture reviews and continuous improvement initiatives.


Technical Leadership & Mentorship

  • Provide guidance and mentorship to architects, tech leads, and senior engineers.
  • Promote best practices in data architecture, engineering, and cloud platform design.
  • Lead design reviews, technical discussions, and knowledge-sharing sessions.


Architecture Documentation

  • Develop architecture artifacts including C4 models and design documentation.
  • Create High-Level Designs (HLDs) and Low-Level Designs (LLDs), including sequence diagrams and data flows.
  • Document functional and non-functional requirements aligned with architectural designs.


Required Qualifications

  • 7+ years of experience in software engineering, data engineering, or architecture roles.
  • Proven experience designing and delivering data platforms on Azure Databricks .
  • Strong understanding of data mesh concepts and domain-oriented data products.
  • Hands-on experience with Unity Catalog (governance, security, lineage).
  • Solid programming experience in Python and/or C# , including API and integration design.
  • Experience designing end-to-end solutions across data platforms, APIs, and cloud infrastructure.
  • Strong knowledge of cloud-native architectures, DevOps practices, and operational considerations.
  • Experience creating architectural artifacts and design documentation.
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
  • Ability to operate in complex environments with ambiguity and evolving requirements.


Preferred Qualifications

  • Prior experience as a Solutions Architect, System Architect, or Senior Technical Lead .
  • Experience working in consulting or large enterprise environments.
  • Familiarity with Agile frameworks (e.g., SAFe) and PI Planning.
  • Experience with diagram-as-code tools such as Structurizr, PlantUML, or Mermaid.


Key Competencies

  • Strategic thinking with a hands-on, delivery-focused mindset
  • Strong problem-solving and analytical skills
  • Ability to bridge business and technical stakeholders
  • Leadership and mentorship capabilities
  • Continuous learning and innovation mindset

title: Senior Data Engineer
description:
Data Engineer

Brazil

Data Analyst II

Important Information

Location: Brazil

Job Mode: Full-time

Work Mode: Work from home

Job Summary


As a SQL & Snowflake Engineer, you will play a key role in the full development lifecycle, translating complex data structures into actionable technical insights with a specific focus on Snowflake and SQL queries. You will be responsible for both querying and analyzing large datasets within the Data Lake to support feature development, ensuring seamless data availability from ingestion through to reporting within an Agile framework. Beyond technical execution, you will act as a key contributor in data modeling, actively participating in technical discussions to help the engineering team understand underlying data patterns and quality issues.

Responsibilities and Duties


  • Digest requirements from the engineering team and specify the implementation of complex SQL queries;
  • Analyze and map underlying data schemas within Snowflake to support application logic;
  • Optimize SQL performance for large-scale data retrieval and reporting;
  • Follow Agile processes and participate actively in data exploration phases;
  • Participate in technical discussions, data quality reviews, and schema design sessions.

Essential Skills


  • Solid Experience with Snowflake (architecture, warehousing, and data sharing);
  • Strong proficiency in Advanced SQL (CTEs, Window Functions, Stored Procedures);
  • Familiarity with ETL/ELT processes and data ingestion tools;
  • Solid experience with version control for database scripts (Git, Liquibase, or dbt).

Highly Desirable Skills


  • Cloud knowledge (AWS/Azure/GCP) regarding data storage (S3/Blob);
  • Experience with Python or scripting for data manipulation;
  • Familiarity with semi-structured data (JSON, Parquet) with Snowflake.

About Encora


Encora is the preferred digital engineering and modernization partner of some of the world’s leading enterprises and digital native companies. With over 9,000 experts in 47+ offices and innovation labs worldwide, Encora’s technology practices include Product Engineering & Development, Cloud Services, Quality Engineering, DevSecOps, Data & Analytics, Digital Experience, Cybersecurity, and AI & LLM Engineering.


At Encora, we hire professionals based solely on their skills and qualifications, and do not discriminate based on age, disability, religion, gender, sexual orientation, socioeconomic status, or nationality.

title: Executivo Comercial Hunter - Grandes Contas - Mercado Pago | Natal, RN.
description:
No Mercado Livre estamos democratizando o comércio e os serviços financeiros para transformar a vida das pessoas na América Latina. Faça parte deste propósito!


Nosso negócio Fintech oferece para toda a região uma proposta de valor integral, que visa democratizar os serviços financeiros e satisfazer as necessidades de mais de 60 milhões de usuários e usuárias.

Disponibilizamos uma plataforma online que permite receber pelas vendas eletrônicas realizadas, tanto dentro como fora do Mercado Livre, e um sistema de códigos QR e dispositivos Point para as vendas realizadas no mundo físico, para milhões de comerciantes, empreendedores e profissionais, damos a possibilidade de processar suas operações com segurança, através de mais de 50 meios de pagamento na América Latina.

Além disso, fornecemos acesso gratuito a uma conta digital que permite pagar, enviar e receber dinheiro, gerar renda e trabalhar com cartões para fazer compras ou saques. Através do Mercado Crédito, concedemos créditos para satisfazer as necessidades daqueles a quem prestamos nossos serviços e potencializar os negócios de quem vende através da nossa plataforma.



Temos um desafio para as pessoas que:

  • Vibram energia empreendedora: são movidas pela curiosidade, nunca desistem e estão focadas em superar seus próprios limites.
  • Dão o máximo, porque adoram trabalhar com compromisso e dedicação.
  • Encaram as mudanças como oportunidades e aprendem com seus erros.
  • A excelência e a execução são primordiais na sua forma de fazer as coisas.
  • Promovem o bom clima, a alegria e a diversão.
  • Sabem como construir com outras pessoas e desfrutam trabalhando em equipe.



Imagine você empreendendo projetos desafiadores, dinâmicos e inovadores, e sendo responsável por:


  • Prospectar ativamente novos clientes com o perfil de Grandes Contas.
  • Atuar de forma consultiva, compreendendo as dores e oportunidades dos clientes para propor soluções completas de valor agregado ao negócio.
  • Gerir todo o funil de vendas, desde a prospecção até o fechamento e onboarding do cliente sendo usuário modelo dos sistemas da companhia.
  • Sustentar relacionamentos estratégicos com clientes e parceiros de negócio e monitorar tendências de mercado, comportamento da concorrência e oportunidades de crescimento para a sua região de atuação.
  • Trabalhar em sinergia com equipes de produtos e operações para garantir a melhor entrega ao cliente.
  • Ser consultivo para atuar no detalhe durante as negociações sobre os serviços financeiros do Mercado Pago, Meios de Pagamento e Software de Gestão.



Requisitos:


  • Possuir graduação completa.
  • Ter experiência na prospecção de clientes para grandes contas no sesgmento de meios de pagamento.
  • Contar com experiência sólida em vendas consultivas B2B nos segmentos de serviços financeiros, adquirência ou meios de pagamento.
  • Possuir vivência comercial em cenários de metas.
  • Possuir disponibilidade para trabalho presencial.
  • Possuir carro próprio.



Nós lhe propomos:

  • Ser parte de uma empresa com espírito empreendedor, na qual adoramos pensar grande e em longo prazo.
  • Ser protagonista de seu desenvolvimento em um ambiente de oportunidades, aprendizagem, crescimento, expansão e projetos desafiadores.
  • Compartilhar e aprender em equipe, com excelentes profissionais e especialistas.
  • Um excelente clima de trabalho, com todo o necessário para você viver uma grande experiência. :)



O Mercado Livre não faz contato oferecendo oportunidades em troca de pagamento de dinheiro. Você tem acesso a todas as oportunidades abertas no nosso site de carreiras. Caso receba pedidos de dinheiro, desconfie!

title: SAP Basis Engineer
description:
Quem Somos

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.

Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 50 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de contratação e solução de TI e estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, recursos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação, avançar em soluções de mão-de-obra e transformar a infraestrutura tecnológica. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.

O que esperar de nós

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os maiores e melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, Transparencia, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. Compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar! Que tal desenvolver sua carreira conosco?

Na Dexian, valorizamos a diversidade.

Acreditamos que diferentes perspectivas, experiências e trajetórias impulsionam a inovação e fortalecem conexões. Por isso, nosso processo de contratação é inclusivo, aberto a candidatos de todas as identidades, habilidades e histórias. Aqui, o que importa é o talento.

Nosso Cliente

description:

description:

title: Server Manager (Global Project) [Inglês Avançado]
description:
Estamos em busca de um Server Manager altamente qualificado para integrar nossa equipe de Enhanced Operation Service (EOS), que faz parte da organização de Enterprise Cloud Services Delivery. Neste papel, você atuará como um consultor de confiança, sendo responsável por salvaguardar e otimizar a entrega de ponta a ponta para clientes estratégicos durante sua jornada de transformação em nuvem.

Você fará parte de um projeto global , integrando um time que atua em uma operação 24x7 para um cliente da Tech Mahindra. Esta é uma posição remota, com alocação mínima prevista de um ano. O horário inicial será de segunda a sexta-feira, das 9h às 18h, porém a escala é passível de alteração ao longo do projeto para atender às necessidades operacionais.


Principais Responsabilidades

Seu trabalho envolverá uma carga de trabalho mista, com foco em manter a estabilidade e a performance do sistema:

  • Gestão de Incidentes e Problemas: Participar ativamente no tratamento de incidentes críticos (Major Incidents), solucionar falhas em solicitações de serviço e realizar análise de causa raiz (RCA) para interrupções ou problemas de desempenho.
  • Solicitações de Serviço e Mudança: Executar solicitações de serviço e mudanças complexas, gerenciando extensões de tempo de inatividade e incidentes de longa duração.
  • Otimização de Performance: Identificar e liderar iniciativas proativas para melhorar a operação, estabilidade e padronização dos sistemas dos clientes.
  • Suporte Técnico Especializado: Fornecer suporte técnico especializado em Linux e infraestrutura, com foco em solução de problemas de disco, servidor e conectividade de rede.
  • Melhoria Contínua: Otimizar procedimentos operacionais padrão (SOPs) por meio de automação e definir planos de ação corretiva para atingir os KPIs estabelecidos.
  • Orquestração e Colaboração: Coordenar o trabalho entre diversas unidades de serviços de nuvem, internos e externos, garantindo uma entrega contínua.


Requisitos Técnicos Centrais

  • Expertise em Linux (Obrigatório): Sólida experiência prática em administração de SUSE, Red Hat ou Ubuntu . É essencial ter vivência real em troubleshooting de performance, disco e sistema.
  • Clustering & HA (Obrigatório - Flexível): Experiência de 2 a 3 anos em configurações de Alta Disponibilidade (HA). Conhecimento em Pacemaker é preferencial, mas outras ferramentas de clustering (como Red Hat HA) são aceitáveis.
  • Proficiência em Nuvem (Obrigatório): Experiência prática em pelo menos um dos principais provedores de nuvem pública: AWS, Azure ou GCP . Experiência em ambientes multi-cloud será considerada um diferencial.
  • Redes: Capacidade avançada para diagnosticar problemas de rede em ambiente Linux e nuvem, incluindo TCP/IP, DNS, LDAP, NAT, firewalls e análise de conectividade.
  • Automação: Experiência com linguagens de script (Shell, Python, Go, etc.) e ferramentas de automação de servidores como Ansible ou CHEF .


Qualificações e Experiência

  • Experiência Profissional: Mínimo 8 a 10 anos de experiência na área de infraestrutura de TI e operações de servidores.
  • Formação Acadêmica: Graduação superior em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia, Gestão de TI ou áreas correlatas.
  • Idioma: Inglês Fluente é imprescindível, dado que toda a interação com o time global, documentação e suporte ao cliente será realizada em inglês.
  • Habilidades Comportamentais: Foco no cliente, pensamento analítico orientado a soluções e capacidade de adquirir novos conhecimentos de forma independente e proativa.


Imporante:

Inglês é Mandatório.

title: Data Operations Analyst
description:
About Us:

YipitData is the leading market research and analytics firm for the disruptive economy and most recently raised $475M from The Carlyle Group at a valuation of over $1B. Every day, our proprietary technology analyzes billions of alternative data points to uncover actionable insights across sectors like software, AI, cloud, e-commerce, ridesharing, and payments.

Our data and research teams transform raw data into strategic intelligence, delivering accurate, timely, and deeply contextualized analysis that our customers—ranging from the world’s top investment funds to Fortune 500 companies—depend on to drive high-stakes decisions. From sourcing and licensing novel datasets to rigorous analysis and expert narrative framing, our teams ensure clients get not just data, but clarity and confidence.

We operate globally with offices in the US (NYC, Austin, Miami, Mountain View), APAC (Hong Kong, Shanghai, Beijing, Guangzhou, Singapore), and India. Our award-winning, people-centric culture—recognized by Inc. as a Best Workplace for three consecutive years—emphasizes transparency, ownership, and continuous mastery.


What It’s Like to Work at YipitData:

YipitData isn’t a place for coasting—it’s a launchpad for ambitious, impact-driven professionals. From day one, you’ll take the lead on meaningful work, accelerate your growth, and gain exposure that shapes careers.


Why Top Talent Chooses YipitData:

  • Ownership That Matters : You’ll lead high-impact projects with real business outcomes
  • Rapid Growth : We compress years of learning into months
  • Merit Over Titles : Trust and responsibility are earned through execution, not tenure
  • Velocity with Purpose: We move fast, support each other, and aim high—always with purpose and intention


If your ambition is matched by your work ethic—and you’re hungry for a place where growth, impact, and ownership are the norm—YipitData might be the opportunity you’ve been waiting for.


About The Role:

The Data Operations Analyst plays a critical role in transforming messy, raw product data into high-quality metrics that our retail and brand customers rely on to analyze performance and make decisions. The core of this role is applying strong judgment to shape imperfect data into consistent, scalable, and analytically meaningful outputs .

Each customer has unique business questions, data structures, and definitions of success. The Data Operations Analyst works closely with internal teams to interpret these needs, resolve ambiguity in the underlying data, and design solutions that balance accuracy, scalability, and customer expectations. This role requires strong analytical thinking, comfort working with incomplete or inconsistent data, and accountability for delivering reliable metrics at scale.


As Our Data Operations Analyst, You Will:

  • Transform raw, messy product and transaction data into structured, customer-ready metrics.
  • Apply judgment to resolve ambiguity in data, including handling incomplete, incorrect, or inconsistent inputs.
  • Define and implement rules and logic that make data analytically meaningful and comparable over time.
  • Build and maintain mappings, benchmarks, and normalization approaches that allow customer data to be analyzed at scale.
  • Execute product categorization and attribution when needed as part of broader metric-building workflows.
  • Identify data quality issues and determine appropriate tradeoffs when perfect data is not available.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to plan and deliver data projects on time and with high accuracy.
  • Ensure consistency and reliability of outputs across customers while accounting for customer-specific nuances.
  • Continuously improve processes and workflows to increase efficiency, accuracy, and scalability.
  • Take ownership of deliverables and be accountable for the quality and usability of the final data.


You Are Likely To Succeed If You Have…

  • 1–3 years of experience working in a data-focused role such as data operations, analytics, research, or data quality.
  • Strong analytical judgment and comfort making decisions in ambiguous or imperfect data environments.
  • Experience turning raw data into structured outputs, metrics, or analyses that others rely on.
  • The ability to reason through edge cases, inconsistencies, and tradeoffs in real-world data.
  • High attention to detail paired with an understanding of how data decisions impact downstream analysis.
  • Strong problem-solving and critical-thinking skills.
  • The ability to manage multiple projects and priorities while maintaining accuracy and accountability.
  • Clear communication skills, including the ability to explain data assumptions and decisions to internal stakeholders.
  • Experience using SQL, Python, or similar tools for data exploration, validation, or automation.
  • Advanced English proficiency (B2–C1 or higher).


Technical Skills (Helpful but Not Required):

  • Comfort working with large datasets using spreadsheets, internal tools, or data platforms.
  • Familiarity with data transformation, data quality checks, or analytics workflows.
  • Exposure to product, retail, or consumer data is a plus.


What We Offer:

  • Our compensation package includes competitive salary and comprehensive benefit offerings.
  • Opportunities to build a career as a manager or individual contributor through our career ladder that promotes based on impact. You will have regular career conversations with your manager where you will discuss your short and long-term career goals. We are committed to helping you develop in your career and offer the potential for internal mobility opportunities
  • We care about your personal life, and we mean it. We offer flexible work hours, a remote-first work environment, flexible vacation, team events, learning reimbursement, and more!
  • Your growth at YipitData is determined by the impact that you make, not by tenure, unnecessary facetime, or office politics. Everyone at YipitData is empowered to learn, self-improve, and master their skills in an environment focused on ownership, respect, and trust.
  • Personal laptop
  • Health and wellness package


Candidates must have primary residency (and be physically located) in the country of hire (AKA Brazil) in order to be considered for the position. If hired, the worker must maintain primary residency in the country of hire in order to be eligible for employment.


We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, gender, gender identity or expression, or veteran status. We are proud to be an equal-opportunity employer.



Kindly submit your application and CV in English.

title: Engenheiro de Dados Sênior
description:
Quem Somos

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.

Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 60 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, projetos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação. Apoiamos nossos clientes para encontrar a melhor maneira que seu gap de talentos seja endereçado, de maneira a suportar seu processo de transformação digital. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). title: Cientista de dados
description:
Quem somos?

Com 8 anos de história, a TerraMagna vive a missão de tornar a agricultura tudo aquilo que o mundo precisa que ela seja. Hoje atua como financiadora da cadeia de insumos do agronegócio, visando ser seu sistema operacional e principal parceiro financeiro. Possui mais de 1 bilhão de reais sob gestão, captou 75 milhões em rodada de investimentos e atua com clientes em todo o Brasil.


O Desafio e o Time de Modelagem

Como uma startup em constante desenvolvimento, nosso ambiente é dinâmico e exige autonomia. O Time de Modelagem é enxuto e focado em resolver problemas complexos de risco de crédito e de análise de dados no agronegócio. Buscamos um Cientista de Dados experiente, com perfil voltado para mentoria e trabalho em equipe.

Acreditamos em um ambiente de trabalho livre e flexível, por isso, a confiança é a base de tudo que fazemos. Valorizamos pessoas movidas a novos desafios, capazes de desbravar o agronegócio e nos ajudar na nossa principal missão, que é levar para o agronegócio o insumo mais importante: o crédito.


Dia a dia

  • Desenvolver, implementar e monitorar modelos estatísticos e de machine learning, especialmente modelos de credit scoring e análise de risco.
  • Produtizar os modelos, trabalhando de forma autônoma desde a concepção até a implementação em ambiente de produção.
  • Colaborar com a liderança técnica na definição da arquitetura de dados e nas escolhas tecnológicas do time.
  • Traduzir problemas complexos de negócio em soluções baseadas em dados, comunicando os resultados de forma clara para audiências técnicas e não técnicas.
  • Colaborar dinamicamente com os times de produto e engenharia.
  • Manter-se atualizado com tendências e melhores práticas em Engenharia e Ciência de Dados.


Requisitos

  • 3+ anos de experiência atuando como Cientista de Dados, preferencialmente em ambientes de startup ou empresas de tecnologia.
  • Domínio em probabilidade e estatística e em modelos de machine learning supervisionados e não supervisionados.
  • Domínio em Python e principais bibliotecas para Ciência de Dados (Pandas, NumPy, Scikit-learn, TensorFlow, etc.).
  • Forte conhecimento em SQL (modelagem, performance e manipulação de grandes volumes de dados).
  • Experiência no desenvolvimento e operacionalização de pipelines de machine learning ponta a ponta em produção (exploração e preparação de dados, limpeza, engenharia de atributos, modelagem e avaliação), com foco em escalabilidade, reprodutibilidade, segurança e monitoramento contínuo de performance dos modelos.
  • Experiência com práticas de engenharia para produção de modelos, incluindo versionamento de código com Git/Github, deploy em nuvem, automação de fluxos e suporte ao monitoramento e manutenção dos modelos em produção.
  • Familiaridade com serviços em nuvem, preferencialmente Google Cloud Platform (GCP).
  • Perfil proativo, com capacidade para atuar em problemas ambíguos, autonomia para estruturar o caminho analítico e excelente habilidade de comunicação para alinhamento com múltiplos stakeholders.
  • Interesse genuíno em evoluir tecnicamente em um ambiente dinâmico de fintech.


Diferenciais

  • Formação acadêmica em Estatística, Ciência da Computação, Ciência de Dados, Engenharias, Matemática, Física, Economia ou áreas correlatas.
  • Experiência prévia com modelagem de risco de crédito, credit scoring ou detecção de fraudes.
  • Conhecimento de metodologias de inferência causal e experimentação.
  • Experiência em projetos envolvendo metaheurísticas aplicadas a problemas de otimização combinatória.
  • Conhecimento ou experiência prévia no setor do Agronegócio (AgTechs).
  • Experiência no setor de serviços financeiros ou em projetos relacionados a crédito e risco.
  • Conhecimento em manuseio de dags (Airflow ou similar) para composição de bases de dados para análises exploratórias e treinamento de modelos.


O que temos por aqui:

  • Trabalho remoto, com encontros ocasionais na sede em São José dos Campos - SP.
  • Remuneração compatível (PJ).
  • Benefício flexível via cartão Swile.
  • Wellhub (antigo Gympass).
  • Convênio médico Porto Saúde.
  • Convênio odontológico Uniodonto.

title: Analista de Processos (Scrum Master) - Júnior
description:
Na Bluesoft, valorizamos o bem-estar de nossos colaboradores, pois acreditamos que um ambiente de trabalho positivo resulta em um trabalho extraordinário que mantém nossos clientes sempre satisfeitos.


Temos uma missão clara: Prover tecnologia para tornar empresas mais ágeis e prósperas. Não apenas buscamos velocidade, mas também adaptabilidade e crescimento contínuo para gerar mais valor aos nossos clientes.


Nossa visão é ousada: Queremos ser a Melhor Empresa de sistemas de gestão do mundo! Acreditamos que é possível alcançar esse objetivo com nossa dedicação e comprometimento.


Nossos valores são o alicerce de tudo o que fazemos:


Integridade: Valorizamos as pessoas e agimos com ética e transparência para conquistar credibilidade e confiança.

Eficácia: Acreditamos em fazer a coisa certa, do jeito certo e rápido.

Engajamento: Na Bluesoft, atuamos com energia, buscamos a excelência e assumimos a responsabilidade coletiva para crescer juntos e alcançar grandes resultados.

Evolução: Estamos sempre buscando ser melhores a cada dia. Valorizamos a humildade e a aprendizagem contínua, e incentivamos a criatividade e a inovação.

Colaboração: Valorizamos a colaboração, o aprendizado mútuo e a união de forças para alcançar grandes conquistas, respeitando diferentes perspectivas e construindo, juntos, um futuro melhor.


Sobre a vaga:


Na Bluesoft , o Analista de Processos (Scrum Master) tem o papel de impulsionar a eficiência e a colaboração entre times, garantindo que nossas entregas aconteçam com clareza, consistência e alinhamento às necessidades dos clientes. Buscamos alguém que seja facilitador, analítico, comunicativo e apaixonado por criar ambientes de trabalho saudáveis e colaborativos


Principais atividades:

  • Facilitar cerimônias ágeis (Daily, Planning, Retrospectiva, Review e Refinamento).
  • Monitorar riscos, identificar gargalos e apoiar o time na tomada de decisão para manter o fluxo de entrega.
  • Acompanhar prazos e demandas junto aos times e áreas envolvidas, apoiando a gestão de projetos quando necessário.
  • Dar visibilidade às métricas e indicadores de performance (ex.: Lead Time, Throughput, Bugs, Previsibilidade).
  • Atuar de forma proativa em situações críticas, ajudando na análise de alternativas e planos de ação sustentáveis.
  • Garantir que as retrospectivas resultem em ações práticas, com responsáveis e acompanhamento contínuo.
  • Manter e atualizar a documentação de processos, propondo melhorias contínuas.
  • Facilitar o alinhamento entre áreas (Produto, Desenvolvimento, QA, Implantação e Processos).
  • Apoiar onboarding de novos integrantes do time e organizar feedbacks para fortalecer a comunicação e aprendizagem.
  • Prover diagnóstico de causa-raiz e múltiplas opções estratégicas para a solução de impedimentos críticos, garantindo que a decisão final seja informada e eficaz.
  • Atuar como um agente de challenge e facilitador de melhorias, questionando processos ineficientes, estimativas não realistas ou decisões que possam comprometer a previsibilidade e a qualidade da entrega
  • Disseminar a cultura ágil, promovendo autonomia, colaboração e evolução contínua.


Requisitos Indispensáveis:

  • Experiência prática com Scrum , Kanban e fundamentos de Lean .
  • Habilidade em comunicação, empatia e facilitação de grupos.
  • Visão sistêmica e capacidade de analisar processos ponta a ponta.
  • Organização e disciplina para acompanhamento de tarefas, ações e métricas.
  • Postura proativa e orientada a soluções, atuando como agente de mudança.
  • Desejo de construir um ambiente colaborativo, transparente e que estimule aprendizados constantes.


Requisitos Desejáveis:

  • Conhecimento em ferramentas de gestão (ex.: Jira, Azure DevOps, Miro).
  • Experiência com times de desenvolvimento de software.
  • Certificações ágeis (CSM, PSM, KSD, KSI ou similares).

title: Regional Sales Executive
description:
We are seeking a driven and results-oriented Regional Sales Executive to drive the regional sales and affiliate partnership efforts in Brazil. Reporting to the Country Manager, you will be responsible for acquiring and managing new affiliate partners, driving the region's growth, and developing strategic relationships to elevate the company’s market position. This full-time role will provide an exciting opportunity to play a pivotal role in the company's expansion while focusing on affiliate partnerships to deliver measurable business growth.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Affiliate Partner Acquisition & Management : Identify, onboard, and manage new affiliate partners, merchants, and strategic partners to expand the company’s affiliate network and drive revenue growth in Brazil.
  • Partnership Development & Negotiation: Negotiate affiliate terms, contracts, and collaboration agreements to ensure mutually beneficial outcomes. Work closely with the marketing team to create tailored campaigns and offers that align with affiliate partners’ audiences and Bybit’s brand.
  • Relationship Management: Maintain regular communication with affiliates, monitoring the performance of partnerships, and providing ongoing support and resources to optimize results. Foster long-term relationships with affiliates, ensuring they have the tools, incentives, and resources to succeed. Act as the main point of contact for affiliates, addressing any issues or concerns in a timely and professional manner.
  • Affiliate Onboarding : Guide new affiliates through the onboarding process, ensuring they are equipped with the necessary tools, resources, and understanding of the company’s offerings to drive performance.
  • Market Insights & Strategy : Conduct in-depth market research to identify emerging trends, competitive strategies, and new affiliate opportunities. Use these insights to refine outreach and acquisition strategies.
  • Sales & Affiliate Reporting : Track and analyze key performance metrics related to affiliate performance, client acquisition, and outreach efforts. Report progress to the Country Manager and provide strategic feedback to improve future efforts.
  • Administrative & Organizational Support : Oversee administrative tasks related to affiliate management, including record-keeping, scheduling meetings, managing communication, and preparing performance reports.
  • Event Coordination : Assist in the planning and execution of events focused on building affiliate partnerships, such as affiliate conferences, merchant meetups, or industry workshops.

Qualifications:

  • Proven experience in sales, affiliate marketing, or business development with a focus on managing relationships and partnerships.
  • Strong communication and negotiation skills, with the ability to effectively pitch affiliate opportunities and build rapport with key stakeholders.
  • Strategic mindset with a keen understanding of affiliate marketing trends, market dynamics, and how to leverage them for business success.
  • Strong organizational skills, capable of handling multiple projects, managing time effectively, and keeping affiliate partners engaged and satisfied.
  • Self-starter with a proactive attitude, attention to detail, and a passion for driving business results through affiliate partnerships.

title: Senior Account Executive
description:
The Role

Our client is a fast-growing B2B SaaS platform built for social media managers, agencies, and brands. We are self-funded, profitable, and moving fast, which means the people here are not here to coast. Everyone on this team has a goal they are building toward and puts in the work to get there. If you are looking for a place where your effort directly shapes company growth and your own earnings, this is it.


We are looking for a sharp, disciplined Account Executive who closes deals without losing the relationship along the way. You are not just good on a call. You are the person who sends the follow-up within the hour, keeps prospects warm through a 30-day cycle, and never lets a qualified lead go cold because of a dropped ball on your end.


You will work inbound leads from our SDR team and marketing channels. Prospecting and sourcing are handled upstream. Your job is to convert.

What you'll do

  • Work exclusively with warm, SDR-qualified and inbound leads. You are not cold calling. You are closing.
  • Run structured discovery calls that uncover real pain, not surface-level answers
  • Deliver demos tailored to what you learned in discovery, not a canned deck
  • Own the full sales cycle from first call to signed contract
  • Keep every open opportunity engaged with timely, relevant follow-up
  • Send clear, concise follow-up emails after every call the same day
  • Maintain clean, accurate pipeline records in CRM at all times
  • Partner with SDRs to ensure tight handoffs and fast response on warm leads
  • Hit and exceed monthly and quarterly revenue targets consistently
  • Feed insights back into messaging, objection handling, and playbooks


Additional Requirements

  • 3+ years of closing experience in a B2B SaaS AE role
  • A track record of consistently exceeding quota. We will ask about this specifically. If attainment has been a struggle at any point, this is not the right fit
  • Exceptional discovery skills. You know how to ask questions that surface real buying motivation and you do not move to demo until you have earned it
  • Organized to a fault. You have a system for follow-up and you never miss a touchpoint because something slipped through the cracks
  • Strong written communication. Your follow-up emails are short, clear, and move the deal forward. Not essays, not templates that feel like templates
  • Fluency in HubSpot or comparable CRM. Pipeline hygiene is not something you need to be reminded about
  • Self-managed. You own your pipeline and your outcomes without needing a manager to push you
  • Resilient and persistent without being annoying. You know the difference between a dead deal and a deal that needs one more touch

Sales

English Communication


Good-to-have Skills

HubSpot

title: AI Automation Specialist
description:
Hey, Dingus!


Yep, you read that right. Dingus & Zazzy is expanding, and we’re on the hunt for a sharp, systems-minded AI Automation Specialist who can build, connect, and scale intelligent workflows that actually work in production.


About Us


Dingus & Zazzy is a global digital marketing agency helping brands grow across every corner of the digital landscape. We offer an “unlimited get-shit-done” subscription for our clients, from websites to social to SEO and everything in between.


Our team is full of creatives, strategists, tech geeks, and builders who love making brands look, feel, and perform better online. If that sounds like your vibe, keep reading.


What You’ll Do


  • Build and maintain automated workflows using N8N, connecting APIs, webhooks, and data sources into seamless pipelines.
  • Integrate and prompt Claude (Anthropic) and other LLMs into production systems, not just experiments.
  • Manage and automate data operations in Airtable, including scripted fields, automations, and structured data pipelines.
  • Design AI-assisted workflows that reduce manual effort across client delivery, internal ops, and content production.
  • Troubleshoot broken pipelines, handle edge cases, and document systems so they don’t live only in your head.
  • Collaborate with strategy and delivery teams to identify automation opportunities and scope builds accurately.
  • Stay current on the AI tooling landscape, you should know what’s worth using before we ask.
  • Own and iterate on AI agent logic and system prompts, understanding why a workflow behaves the way it does and improving it over time.
  • Build net-new internal AI tools as the business identifies opportunities, not just maintain what exists.


What You Bring


  • 2+ years of hands-on experience building automated workflows (N8N, Make.com, or Zapier, N8N strongly preferred).
  • Real experience integrating LLMs via API (Claude, GPT, or equivalent) into production pipelines with structured outputs.
  • Proficiency in Airtable as a data layer, scripting, automations, relational structures.
  • Solid understanding of REST APIs, JSON, and webhook-based integrations.
  • Basic scripting ability in Python or JavaScript, enough to write and debug function nodes without hand-holding.
  • A working understanding of HTML and CSS is imperative, you need to be able to read, interpret, and make sense of front-end structure when workflows touch web-based outputs.
  • A systems thinker mindset: you design the whole loop, not just the happy path.
  • Ability to work independently in a fully remote, fast-paced environment.
  • Comfort with versioning and testing AI outputs, you notice when a prompt change breaks something and know how to fix it.


Bonus Points


  • Experience with vector databases or basic RAG pipelines (Pinecone, Supabase, etc.).
  • Familiarity with AI agent frameworks (LangChain, or equivalent concepts).
  • Experience in a digital agency or client-services environment.
  • Exposure to prompt engineering best practices, like system prompts, chaining, few-shot design.


Work Details


  • Hours: 9 A.M. – 5 P.M. MST, Monday to Friday
  • Requires a working level of written and spoken English


If you’re someone who can look at a messy manual process, see the system hiding inside it, and build something that runs without you, we want to hear from you.


Ready for the ride of your life? Apply now!

title: Analista de infraestrutura Junior - Linux
description:

  • Presta suporte técnico aos usuários, solucionando problemas relacionados aos servidores, respondendo a solicitações de suporte e fornecendo orientações sobre o uso adequado dos recursos disponíveis;

  • Mantém a documentação atualizada dos servidores, registrando configurações, alterações e procedimentos relevantes para referência futura e garantindo a consistência nas operações;
  • Mantém-se atualizado com as tendências e avanços tecnológicos relacionados à infraestrutura de servidores, buscando oportunidades de melhoria e otimização dos sistemas;
  • Participar das cerimônias ágeis, como reuniões de planejamento, retrospectivas e revisões, compartilhando informações sobre a infraestrutura de servidores e colaborando para a melhoria contínua do squad ágil.


O QUE ESPERAMOS DE VOCÊ:

Formação: Graduação em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia de Computação, Sistemas de Informação ou área relacionada (desejável). ●

Conhecimentos:

  • Windows Server: Configuração e administração de servidores Windows, incluindo Active Directory, DHCP, DNS e funções de servidor.
  • Linux: Conhecimentos básicos de administração de sistemas Linux, gerenciamento de pacotes e comandos do shell.
  • Backup: Familiaridade com estratégias e ferramentas de backup, para garantir a proteção e recuperação de dados.
  • Redes: Compreensão dos conceitos básicos de redes, protocolos (TCP/IP) e configuração de dispositivos de rede.
  • Administração de servidores: Gerenciamento de servidores físicos e virtuais, incluindo instalação e configuração.
  • Virtualização: Conhecimento em tecnologias de virtualização como VMware ou Hyper-V.
  • Armazenamento: Noções sobre armazenamento de dados, RAID e tecnologias de armazenamento em rede (NAS e SAN).
  • Segurança da informação: Conhecimentos básicos de práticas de segurança cibernética e controle de acesso.
  • Monitoramento e resolução de problemas: Utilização de ferramentas de monitoramento para detectar e solucionar problemas de infraestrutura.
  • Automação e scripting: Habilidades básicas de automação usando scripts como PowerShell ou Shell Script.
  • Resolução de problemas: Capacidade de analisar e solucionar questões relacionadas à infraestrutura de TI.
  • Certificações relevantes em infraestrutura de servidores, como Microsoft Certified: Azure Administrator Associate, VMware Certified Professional (VCP), Linux Professional Institute Certification (LPIC), entre outras. (desejável)


INFORMAÇÕES ADICIONAIS

Antes de mostrar nossos benefícios, deixa eu já te contar uma coisa: aqui as coisas acontecem em um ritmo acima da média.

A rotina em uma empresa de tecnologia é alucinante e o aprendizado é contínuo e diário. O melhor disso é que temos autonomia para colocar esse aprendizado em prática e buscar resultados.

title: Sr. Backend Engineer (Node.js)
description:
About You

You are a senior-level Backend Engineer (Node.js) who thrives in challenging environments and enjoys taking ownership of complex systems to transform them into secure, scalable, and production-ready solutions.


You are highly hands-on and comfortable working with evolving or partially structured codebases. You can quickly assess risks, identify critical issues, and execute remediation strategies under tight timelines. You value clean code, security best practices, and reliable system behavior.


You collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams, communicate technical challenges clearly, and play a key role in stabilizing applications and restoring confidence in production systems. You are motivated by making a tangible impact and contributing to the successful relaunch and future scalability of a critical platform.


You Bring to Applaudo the Following Competencies:

  • 5+ years of hands-on experience in backend development using Node.js.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, IT, or equivalent professional experience.
  • Strong experience working with REST APIs and third-party integrations.
  • Proven experience handling legacy systems, codebase audits, or technical recovery scenarios.
  • Solid understanding of application security best practices, including secure handling of sensitive data.
  • Hands-on experience with AWS environments and services.
  • Experience setting up or troubleshooting CI/CD pipelines.
  • Strong experience working with PostgreSQL databases (RDS preferred).
  • Familiarity with proxies, CORS, and common web security vulnerabilities (e.g., SSRF).
  • Ability to work in fast-paced environments with ambiguous or incomplete documentation.
  • Strong problem-solving skills with the ability to prioritize issues based on business impact.
  • Experience collaborating with mobile teams (React Native is a plus).
  • Advanced English proficiency is required, as you will work directly with US-based clients.


You Will Be Accountable for the Following Responsibilities:

  • Take ownership of the Node.js backend and perform a full technical assessment of the codebase.
  • Identify and remediate critical security vulnerabilities and insecure integrations.
  • Refactor unstable or low-quality code to improve reliability, maintainability, and performance.
  • Stabilize core application flows required for production readiness.
  • Re-establish codebase ownership by organizing and migrating repositories within the client environment.
  • Analyze and restore CI/CD pipelines across repositories and environments.
  • Set up and validate staging environments to support testing and release processes.
  • Audit and stabilize third-party integrations such as payments and external platforms.
  • Collaborate with QA and stakeholders to validate functionality and prioritize fixes.
  • Support release readiness and launch execution ensuring system stability.
  • Enforce a feature-freeze approach focused on stabilization and critical fixes.
  • Contribute to defining a post-launch roadmap to support scalability and future development.
  • Continuously improve system security, performance, and operational stability.


Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience in Node.js backend development.
  • Experience working with legacy systems, system stabilization, or technical recovery projects.
  • Strong experience with AWS, CI/CD pipelines, and PostgreSQL.
  • Solid understanding of backend security and API integrations.
  • Advanced English proficiency.


Additional Information

About Us


We Are Engineered Different.


At Applaudo, talented people design, build, and scale meaningful, AI-powered solutions that create real business impact. As an AI-native organization, we collaborate across design, development, cloud, data, and artificial intelligence to turn ideas into scalable products that transform how companies operate, make decisions, and grow.


We are building a high-performance culture grounded in five values: Empowering Excellence, Collaborative Teamwork, Unsolicited Respect, Consistent Transparency, and Efficient Communication . These define how we work, how we support one another, and how we hold ourselves accountable.


Applaudo is a place for people who want to learn fast, take ownership, and work alongside strong teams they are proud to belong to. Joining us means being part of an organization that is evolving intentionally, investing in modern ways of working, and leading AI-native transformation at scale.

title: Sales Enablement Specialist, Digital Course & Access Programs
description:
JoVE is the world-leading producer and provider of science video solutions with the mission to improve scientific research and education. Millions of scientists, educators and students use JoVE for their research, teaching and learning. Our institutional clients comprise over 1,000 universities, colleges, and biopharma companies, including such leaders as Harvard, MIT, Yale, and Stanford. As a rapidly growing company, with offices in the USA, UK, Australia, and India servicing clients in over 60 countries, we are seeking talented and ambitious individuals to join our company.


The Role

JoVE is seeking a Sales Enablement Specialist - Digital Course Materials & Access Programs to support the operational delivery and adoption of JoVE’s digital science video platform across higher education institutions.

This role sits within the Sales Enablement team and focuses on managing course material adoptions, supporting bookstore affordability programs such as Inclusive Access and Equitable Access, and ensuring the reliable delivery of JoVE content through Learning Management Systems (LMS).

While JoVE’s Customer Success team works directly with faculty on course-level implementation, this role focuses on operational workflows, adoption tracking, data analysis, and identifying trends or systemic issues affecting digital course material delivery.

The ideal candidate combines strong operational and analytical skills with meaningful experience working with LMS platforms and LTI-based integrations used in higher education courseware delivery.


Responsibilities:

  • Manage course material adoptions and digital product fulfillment across higher education accounts.
  • Support the implementation and administration of Inclusive Access and Equitable Access programs with university bookstores.
  • Coordinate course setup and delivery of digital materials through bookstore distribution systems.
  • Analyze sales, adoption, and fulfillment data to create reports and dashboards that support forecasting, planning, and decision-making.
  • Provide insights to Sales leadership on adoption performance and program growth.
  • Identify trends, gaps, and opportunities in bookstore and digital distribution workflows.
  • Monitor workflows that support JoVE content delivery through Learning Management Systems (Canvas, Blackboard, Moodle, D2L, etc.). Recommend process improvements and system enhancements to support scalable program delivery.
  • Apply working knowledge of LTI integrations and LMS courseware delivery models to diagnose access or authentication issues.


Requirements

  • A Bachelor’s degree
  • 3+ years experience in EdTech, digital publishing, sales operations, or academic technology environments
  • Strong familiarity with Learning Management Systems (Canvas, Blackboard, Moodle, Brightspace, etc.)
  • Demonstrated experience working with LTI integrations or LMS-based courseware delivery
  • Strong experience using Salesforce or similar CRM platforms
  • Results-driven, strong organization and analytical skills
  • Ability to work independently in a fast paced environment


Why JoVE?

  • A competitive compensation package.
  • You will make a direct impact in accelerating science research and education.
  • Opportunity to work with global teams and in an environment that promotes innovation and collaboration.
  • Our strong promotion from within culture draws a clear path to advance your career with us

title: Landholder and Reforestation Delivery Manager
description:
About NatureCo

NatureCo delivers nature-based solutions (NbS) for investors, corporates and other purpose driven organisations to scale up action on climate change and biodiversity loss. We specialise in nature-based project development including reforestation, agroforestry, farmer managed natural regeneration and mangrove restoration. NatureCo has extensive expertise in working with local communities to protect and restore natural ecosystems through participation in the global voluntary carbon market.

NatureCo is currently implementing a large-scale reforestation project in Brazil for the generation of verified carbon credits.

We are a diverse, mission-driven team that values inclusion, integrity, and innovation. NatureCo is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer, committed to building an equitable and inclusive workplace for all.

Role and responsibilities

The Landholder and Reforestation Delivery Manager is the primary field-based interface with landholders, communities, reforestation contractors, and other local stakeholders for NatureCo’s projects in Brazil. This position will build and manage a pipeline of landholders interested in reforestation, lead outreach and onboarding, coordinate site inspections, lead the collection of relevant data required for carbon standard checks, and lead signature of landholder agreements. The role will also play a key role in ensuring compliance (contracts and carbon standards) as well as coordinate schedules between landholders and contractors for the implementation of reforestation activities. This will include confirming site readiness, conducting periodic field quality audits, documenting and tracking progress, and resolving issues that could delay delivery or degrade quality.

The role requires a strong combination stakeholder engagement and management experience, and a commitment to quality and impact. The role requires extensive travel and field work across Minas Gerais, Bahia and Espírito Santo.


Primary roles and responsibilities include:

Landholder engagement, onboarding, and pipeline management

  • Map priority municipalities and referral partner networks (city governments, co-ops, farmer associations, NGOs); plan and run outreach activities, events and information sessions.
  • Manage the landholder onboarding process (identify → qualify → onboard → contract), using CRM/trackers to keep status, documents and next actions current.
  • Prepare clear information packs (benefits, obligations, timelines) and respond to inquiries in a timely, professional manner.
  • Maintain ongoing landholder relationship management to support retention, satisfaction, and smooth site access throughout implementation.

Eligibility, due diligence & agreements

  • Coordinate site inspections and initial diagnostics in consultation with other team members (parcel boundaries, vegetation status, access, water, risks).
  • Support land tenure verification and FPIC documentation
  • Lead closure of contract signatures.
  • Maintain organized repository of all landholder records within NatureCo’s data management system

(land titles, eligibility documents, contracts, site maps, inspection notes, photos, consultation records).

Reforestation delivery enablement

  • Translate signed landholder agreements into implementation-ready site plans (site-specific scope, access instructions, constraints, schedule windows).
  • Align field schedules with landholders and contractors to ensure access, minimize disruption to farm activities, and maintain trust and cooperation.
  • Support in the delivery of field delivery progress from contractors by site (start/finish dates, activities completed, challenges, next steps), and escalate issues early (access, weather delays, input shortages, labor constraints).
  • Support in monitoring reforestation activities (during and post planting) and coordinate, where required, rapid response with contractors/landholders (grazing, fire risk, pests, drought stress).

Stakeholder engagement and safeguards

  • Plan and document stakeholder consultations and community meetings in accordance with NatureCo policies and procedures (agendas, attendance lists, minutes, photos).
  • Support the team in the operation of the grievance mechanism: receiving grievances and responding in accordance with the NatureCo grievance mechanism.
  • Maintain landholder contact and ensure landholder information is kept up to date.
  • Coordinate access, for other project staff and contractors as required.

Reporting

  • Lead or assist the development of formal monthly, quarterly, and annual project implementation reports for internal and external stakeholders in line with contract and/or carbon standard requirements.
  • Prepare ad hoc reports, documents, and presentations for internal and external stakeholders.

Teamwork and culture

  • Support the management of a cross-functional, international team, fostering collaboration and ensuring that project milestones and goals are met.
  • Stay current on emerging best practices in NbS and carbon projects; proactively share insights across the organisation and with partners.


Skills and attributes

To perform successfully in this role, you will have:

  • A minimum of five (5) years of experience in reforestation projects with direct contact with rural landholders and reforestation planting service providers.
  • Degree in forest engineering, agronomy, ecology, or environmental science.
  • Intermediate English and native Portuguese language skills
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to engage confidently across cultures and stakeholder groups.
  • Strong project management skills, including experience managing timelines, deliverables, and working across multidisciplinary teams.
  • A proactive, self-starting approach with the ability to anticipate problems, adapt quickly, and take initiative under limited supervision.
  • A collaborative mindset and ability to lead and motivate internal teams and external partners
  • Ability to provide strategic and technical guidance across complex, multi-stakeholder projects.
  • Strong organisational skills and attention to detail in documentation and reporting.
  • A positive, energetic personality with resilience and drive to see projects through to delivery.


Extensive travel within Brazil is a requirement to perform this position.


Location

We are seeking a highly analytical and detail-oriented Senior Financial Analyst to support financial operations, reporting, and billing processes. This role will act as a key partner across Finance, Sales, and Customer Success teams, ensuring alignment between contracts, invoicing, and revenue recognition.   • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and organizational skills

Nice to Have

  • Experience with billing or subscription-based business models

  • Background in process optimization and financial systems improvements
  • Experience working in high-growth or scaling organizations.


What We Offer

  • Competitive compensation

  • High-impact role supporting financial strategy and operations
  • Collaborative and fast-growing environment with strong ownership.

title: Financial Reporting Analyst
description:
Financial Reporting Analyst


Location: Remote (Brazil)


About Sphise Technologies


Sphise Technologies is a global outsourcing and talent solutions company, partnering with high-growth businesses to build strong, high-impact teams across finance, technology, and operations. Our trusted partner is expanding its financial operations and is seeking a Financial Reporting Analyst tto support financial reporting, analysis, and data-driven decision-making, ensuring accuracy, visibility, and actionable insights across the business.


Position Overview

We are seeking a highly analytical and detail-oriented Financial Reporting Analyst / Accountant to support financial reporting, accounting operations, and data-driven decision-making across the organization.

This role bridges financial reporting and accounting, ensuring accurate financial records, reliable reporting, and actionable insights. The ideal candidate combines strong accounting fundamentals with analytical capabilities, contributing to both operational excellence and strategic visibility.


What You'll Do

  • Prepare and analyze monthly, quarterly, and annual financial reports
  • Maintain accuracy and integrity of financial data across reports and systems
  • Support general accounting activities, including reconciliations and journal entries
  • Ensure proper classification and recording of financial transactions
  • Assist in month-end and year-end close processes
  • Identify trends, variances, and key drivers of financial performance
  • Deliver insights to support business and financial decision-making
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to gather and validate financial data
  • Support audits and ensure compliance with accounting standards and policies
  • Improve financial reporting processes, tools, and documentation
  • Perform ad-hoc analysis and support finance-related initiatives


What You Bring

  • Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, or a related field
  • 4–7+ years of experience in financial reporting, accounting, or similar roles
  • Strong understanding of financial statements and accounting principles
  • Experience with month-end close and reconciliations
  • Advanced proficiency in Excel or Google Sheets
  • Experience with ERP or accounting systems is a plus
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
  • High attention to detail and accuracy
  • Ability to work with large datasets and translate data into insights
  • Strong communication skills and ability to work cross-functionally


Nice to Have

  • CPA or equivalent certification (or in progress)
  • Experience with financial reporting tools or BI platforms (e.g., Power BI, Tableau)
  • Familiarity with financial controls and compliance processes
  • Experience in high-growth or scaling environments
  • Background in process improvement and automation


What We Offer

  • Competitive compensation
  • Fully remote work environment
  • Opportunity to work with modern financial systems and tools
  • Collaborative and fast-growing environment with strong ownership.


Please ensure that your application, including your CV, is submitted in English, as this is a requirement for the recruitment process.

title: Senior Helpdesk Support Specialist
description:

You will serve as a key escalation point, performing in-depth diagnostics, implementing solutions, and managing small IT projects. Key responsibilities include basic network connectivity triage for LAN, WAN, and wireless access points, asset management administration, and maintaining a comprehensive knowledge base to enable proactive problem resolution. This role requires performing basic Active Directory tasks, Microsoft 365 troubleshooting, and device management using Microsoft Intune, ensuring the daily performance and stability of our computer systems. Position title: Senior Helpdesk Support SpecialistLocation: Remote - LATAM
Key Responsibilities
  • Help supervise ticket flow in Jira, ensuring proper triage, routing, and escalation.

  • Utilize Microsoft Intune for key device management functions.
  • Administer the IT asset management system, ensuring accurate tracking and documentation of software assets.

  • Design and conduct training sessions for computer users to enhance their technical proficiency and understanding of IT systems.
  • Manage and progress tickets in Jira Service Management, including triage, updates, proper routing, and escalation.
  • Basic familiarity with endpoint security and antivirus concepts is helpful, issues are typically escalated to the appropriate security team.
Required Skills & Experience
  • Proven experience providing remote help desk and desktop support, including diagnosing, guiding, and resolving issues related to computer hardware, software, and peripherals through virtual and phone-based assistance.
  • Demonstrated leadership abilities, including experience providing technical guidance, coaching, and mentoring to junior help desk technicians.
  • Working knowledge of help desk software and remote control tools.
  • Experience working in Jira Service Management, or strong experience with similar ITSM ticketing systems and workflows.
  • Experience with basic Active Directory user management, such as password changes and account unlocks, and providing end-user troubleshooting for Microsoft 365.
  • Proficiency in resolving basic connectivity issues for Local Area Networks (LAN), Wide Area Networks (WAN), and wireless access points through basic triage.
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to develop training materials and maintain a knowledge base.
  • Proven ability to manage small IT projects and perform asset management administration.
  • Familiarity with Microsoft Intune for device enrollment.
Nice to Have Skills
  • Professional IT certifications, such as CompTIA A+, Network+, or Microsoft IT Support.
  • Familiarity with Microsoft Intune for device enrollment via Windows Autopilot and performing machine resets.
  • Experience with PowerShell scripting to automate routine administrative tasks.
  • Knowledge of supporting additional operating systems, such as macOS, iOS, or Android.
  • Experience with advanced network troubleshooting using command-line tools.
Soft Skills
  • Demonstrated leadership capabilities, with a focus on coaching, mentoring, and providing technical guidance to junior team members to foster their growth and ensure overall team success.
  • Exceptional communication skills (verbal, written, and presentation), with the ability to convey complex technical solutions clearly to clients of varying proficiency levels and to conduct effective training sessions.
  • Advanced analytical and troubleshooting abilities, characterized by a proactive approach to not only resolve immediate issues but also to identify root causes and implement solutions that prevent future occurrences.
  • A strong client-centric mindset, demonstrating the ability to understand problems from the user's perspective and guide them through the resolution process with patience and clarity.
  • Proven ability to work effectively within a high-performing team environment, collaborating with colleagues and assisting other IT support teams to share knowledge and achieve common goals.
  • Excellent organizational and multitasking skills, including the ability to manage small IT projects, maintain meticulous attention to detail, and exercise sound judgment in tracking, routing, and escalating support tickets.
Why You Will Love Working with Us
Join a powerful tech workforce and help us change the world through technology Professional development opportunities with international customers Collaborative work environment Career path and mentorship programs that will lead to new levels. Join Lean Tech and contribute to shaping the data landscape within a dynamic and growing organization. Your skills will be honed, and your contributions will play a vital role in our continued success. Lean Tech is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusiveenvironment for all employees.

The senior-level position will be part of the client's Intelligence team. Responsibilities will focus on designing, building, and maintaining scalable data pipelines and infrastructure that converts raw data into a format ready for ingestion by a BI tool. title: Full-Stack Developer
description:
Join one of the most exciting early-stage platforms as we scale our engineering team globally.


You’ll be building on your full-stack experience, evolving a platform that balances cutting-edge tech with real-world stability. We are looking for a pragmatic \"builder\" who is comfortable in a fast-moving, early-stage environment and can take a feature from a raw idea to a polished delivery.
