title: English Teacher with Advanced Portuguese Skills
description:
Are you a Portuguese speaker who graduated as an English Teacher? We are looking for you!

Teach fun English classes online via Zoom from the comfort of your own home! You can set your own hours and teach on the go as long as you have a solid color backdrop, a laptop, good WiFi, a webcam, and a microphone.


If you love teaching, but dread prepping for lessons and grading, this is the perfect job for you. We provide our teachers with all the lesson materials so all you have to do is show up for class and do what you do best, which is teach!

Whether you’re looking for a second stream of income or a full-time job, we’ve got you covered. You can work as little as 16 hours a month up to as much as 30 hours a week.


What is a typical day for an Online English Teacher at LatinHire?

You will be scheduled shifts two weeks in advance according to the availability you provide us and we also offer the flexibility of dropping shifts and picking up extra shifts.

If you are busier one week, you can drop some of your shifts and have other teachers help you out or if you want to earn more $$ another week, you can pick up extra shifts and help other teachers out.

When you are on shift, you log on to our platform and teach the lessons provided as well as write short feedback for the students after class. Simple as that!


In short, here are some reasons why you will love working as an Online English Teacher with LatinHire:


  • Up to 30 hours of shifts available per week!
  • You be your own boss and set your own schedule
  • Work from anywhere (as long as you have good WiFi, workspace, computer, webcam, and microphone).
  • Depending on the number of hours you decide to teach and on your schedule, you can earn up to USD 900+ per month.


Minimum Requirements:


  • Portuguese as a first language.
  • C1 or C2 Level English Speaker
  • University degree in English Teaching or related area.
  • One year of experience in teaching English as a foreign language.
  • Access to a computer with a reliable, high-speed (at least 2MB) internet connection.
  • Must pass a criminal background check.
  • Teachers must provide at least ten (10) hours of weekly availability.


Who we are:

Established in 2003, LatinHire recruits and manages teams of subject matter experts (SMEs) for online education companies. For over 20 years, our teams have played key roles in the backend of very successful educational startups.

  • Certificações dos treinamentos feitos dentro da comunidade que garantem que você obterá mais resultados juntos aos seus alunos e que agregam na sua carreira como professor independente.


Como saber se você é a pessoa certa para fazer parte da maior comunidade de professores independentes do Brasil?


Se você tem grandes ambições para impactar a educação no Brasil, acredita que o ensino de idiomas precisa de inovação, quer otimizar sua agenda de aulas e, ainda, gostaria de crescer como empreendedor, este é o lugar certo para você.

  • Independência para executar atividades, espírito de colaboração e vontade de contribuir para uma comunidade.


O diferencial?


Aqui você é mais que um professor.


Você será parte de uma comunidade de professores no ensino de idiomas , onde o trabalho colaborativo é a base para alcançar resultados de mercado altamente competitivos.


Esta não é uma vaga CLT , mas sim uma oportunidade de empreender e ser dono do seu crescimento com total suporte e estrutura de uma empresa inovadora.


Você cria laços e relações de confiança com pessoas que realmente se esforçam para te ajudar no seu desenvolvimento, devido ao modelo de negócio inovador que proporciona relações colaborativas e efetivas.


Se você tem vontade de fazer diferente e de vivenciar algo novo na sua história profissional, a ii com certeza é o seu lugar.


Faça parte da mudança no ensino de idiomas. Junte-se à Idioma Independente e transforme sua carreira e a vida de milhares de alunos!


O que eu faço?


  • Recebo capacitação para dar a melhor aula experimental da sua vida

Se você quiser ir além, também será possível, basta você se engajar na comunidade e aprender mais sobre todas as áreas do seu negócio.

title: Senior Salesforce Developer
description:
Senior Salesforce Developer

Brazil


Important Information

Location: Brazil

Job Mode: Full-time

Work Mode: Work from home

Job Summary

We are seeking an experienced Senior Salesforce Developer with Data Cloud experience to support a strategic initiative focused on reducing customer churn by integrating and enriching customer data across multiple platforms. This role will work closely with the Salesforce Architect, data engineering teams, and cross-functional partners to ingest, unify, and expose data within Salesforce CRM and Salesforce Data 360 (Data Cloud).

Responsibilities and Duties

  • Lead end-to-end ingestion and mapping of customer data from Salesforce CRM, Siebel, Azure/Microsoft Fabric, Oracle, and churn model outputs into Salesforce Data 360;
  • Design, build, and maintain identity and account unification rules to produce accurate customer matching and golden records;
  • Create scalable, repeatable pipelines for ingestion, transformation, mapping, and controlled promotion across environments (including Data 360 data kits);
  • Enrich Salesforce CRM records with Data 360 attributes and analytics/model insights (e.g., churn) using related lists, dynamic related lists, and custom UI components;
  • Support CRM data strategy during the Siebel-to-Salesforce migration, prioritizing Salesforce CRM as the system of engagement as adoption increases;
  • Develop and support APIs and integration services for secure internal consumption of Data 360 and CRM data; partner with architecture/engineering on integration patterns and implement ETL when native connectors don’t meet requirements;
  • Monitor and optimize Data 360 credit consumption to balance cost, performance, and SLAs;
  • Enable business teams to use enriched customer data for segmentation, activation, and analytics use cases;
  • Document processes, standards, and runbooks; contribute to shared enablement resources to drive adoption and operational continuity.

Essential Skills

  • Experience with Salesforce development;
  • Strong proficiency in: Apex, SOQL/SOSL, Lightning Web Components (LWC), Salesforce core data model, Salesforce APIs (REST/SOAP/Bulk), and integration design patterns;
  • Hands-on experience with Data ingestion and harmonization, Identity resolution and unification rules, Data kits and environment promotion, Large-scale data processing;
  • Experience connecting Salesforce Data Cloud/Data 360 to external systems (Azure/Microsoft Fabric, Oracle, Siebel, or similar), including when to use native connectors vs. custom integrations;
  • Experience with ETL processes and/or tools (e.g., Informatica, MuleSoft, Talend, Databricks);
  • Experience working in Agile/Scrum teams;
  • Strong technical communication skills, able to translate complex concepts for architects, engineers, business users, and leadership;
  • Advanced English to be in contact with customer representative on a daily basis.

Highly Desirable Skills

  • Experience with Salesforce Marketing Cloud, especially data activation and segmentation;
  • Experience with Siebel CRM integration and/or data migration;
  • Knowledge of telecom customer data, churn analytics, or Customer 360 implementations;
  • Familiarity with Azure data engineering and Microsoft Fabric connector limitations;
  • Understanding of scalable deployment pipelines and DevOps tooling (Git, CI/CD).

About Encora


Encora is the preferred digital engineering and modernization partner of some of the world’s leading enterprises and digital native companies. With over 9,000 experts in 47+ offices and innovation labs worldwide, Encora’s technology practices include Product Engineering & Development, Cloud Services, Quality Engineering, DevSecOps, Data & Analytics, Digital Experience, Cybersecurity, and AI & LLM Engineering.


At Encora, we hire professionals based solely on their skills and qualifications, and do not discriminate based on age, disability, religion, gender, sexual orientation, socioeconomic status, or nationality.

title: DevOps Engineer SR
description:
DevOps Engineer SR


Important Information

Location: Brazil

Job Mode: Full-time

Work Mode: Work from home

Job Summary


This is a highly sensitive and mission‑critical role with admin‑level access to the core platform. The ideal professional is exceptionally reliable, security‑minded, technically strong, and trustworthy, ensuring the stability, performance, and resilience of cloud infrastructure supporting large‑scale production systems.

You will lead cloud operations, infrastructure automation, observability, and performance optimization across AWS environments, ensuring secure, cost‑efficient, and scalable solutions.

Responsibilities and Duties


  • Manage and optimize AWS infrastructure including ECS (Fargate & EC2), EC2, RDS/Aurora, S3, IAM, ALB/NLB, Route 53, CloudFront, and WAF;
  • Design, deploy, and maintain Infrastructure as Code using AWS CloudFormation;
  • Own and enhance CI/CD pipelines using CircleCI or similar tools, including automated deployments, rollback strategies, and environment versioning;
  • Implement and maintain observability frameworks leveraging tools such as New Relic and Splunk for monitoring, logging, alerting, and incident response;
  • Diagnose and resolve performance bottlenecks across databases, services, network layers, and workloads;
  • Lead AWS cost‑optimization initiatives, ensuring performance and reliability remain uncompromised;
  • Collaborate with cross‑functional engineering, architecture, and operations teams to support deployments, troubleshoot issues, and evolve platform capabilities;
  • Ensure best‑in‑class security practices for sensitive production environments, including IAM hardening and compliance with internal controls.


Essential Skills


  • Expertise with ECS (Fargate & EC2), EC2, RDS/Aurora, S3, IAM, ALB/NLB, Route 53, CloudFront, and WAF;
  • Strong experience with CloudFormation for managing AWS infrastructure;
  • Hands-on experience with CircleCI or similar tools, including deployment automation and rollback strategies;
  • Proficiency with monitoring and logging tools like New Relic, and Splunk;
  • Ability to identify and resolve performance bottlenecks in database queries, configurations, and infrastructure;
  • Experience reducing AWS costs while maintaining or improving system reliability and performans.

Highly Desirable Skills


  • Hands-on experience operating Amazon Aurora MySQL/Postgres in production environments, including version upgrade procedures, performance tuning, and troubleshooting;
  • Strong understanding of Aurora architecture, read replicas, automated backups, point-in-time recovery, failover mechanisms, and high availability patterns;
  • Proven track record performing database version upgrades in production with minimal downtime, including compatibility testing, replication management, and performance validation.

title: Remote Business Analyst (German) - 54879
description:
About Turing:

Turing is one of the world’s fastest-growing AI companies accelerating the advancement and deployment of powerful AI systems.

Turing helps customers in two ways: Working with the world’s leading AI labs to advance frontier model capabilities in thinking, reasoning, coding, agentic behavior, multimodality, multilinguality, STEM and frontier knowledge; and leveraging that work to build real-world AI systems that solve mission-critical priorities for companies.


Role Overview:

We are looking for candidates with strong analytical and English comprehension skills. The ideal candidate should have the ability to read, summarize, and break down large content into smaller logical blocks, conduct research online, validate claims made in the content through online research, and work with the LLM (Large Language Models) to solve puzzles!

Your role is critical in helping fine-tune and improve large language models (like gpt), and will make you an expert on how to leverage AI to be a better analyst. This is your chance to future-proof your career in an AI-first world!


What does day-to-day look like:

You would spend time answering a variety of interesting analytical questions and creating scenarios that can train the LLM models to get better. Here are a couple of examples which models might get wrong and you would have to give the correct answer and explanation to enable the models to learn:

  • Based on a given distribution of sales by month across locations, could you analyze which location has grown the most? (Hint: what time period should we look at? should we account for sudden variability at the beginning?)
  • In a small town, there are four distinct neighborhoods: Oak, Pine, Maple, and Elm. A postman is assigned to deliver mail and can only deliver to two neighborhoods in one day, with certain rules (e.g. Oak is always visited before Pine). If he delivers to Oak and Elm on the first day, which neighborhoods does the carrier deliver to on the second day? Note: No other prior specialized domain experience is needed.


Requirements:

  • Multilingual capabilities are mandatory. (English and German)
  • Analytical Skills : Good research and analytical skills
  • Feedback Skills : Ability to provide constructive feedback and detailed annotations.
  • Creative Thinking : Creative and lateral thinking abilities.
  • Communication : Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
  • Independence : Self-motivated and able to work independently in a remote setting.
  • Commitment : Ability to commit to 40 hours per week for the contract duration overlapping US hours.
  • Technical Setup : Desktop/Laptop set up with a good internet connection.


Preferred Qualifications:

  • Bachelors degree or undergraduate in Engineering, Literature, Journalism, Communications, Arts, Statistics, or a related field. We are open to candidates who do not have a Bachelor's degree but have experience in the area.
  • Experience writing professionally (business analysts, research analyst, copywriter, journalist, technical writer, editor, translator, etc.)
  • Understanding of Excel and Google Suite.
  • Proficiency in Data interpretation, Logical reasoning and Basic arithmetic is highly desirable.


Perks of Freelancing With Turing:

  • Work in a fully remote environment.
  • Opportunity to work on cutting-edge AI projects with leading LLM companies.
  • Potential for contract extension based on performance and project needs.


Offer Details:

  • Engagement type : Contractor assignment/freelancer (no medical/paid leave)
  • Commitments Required : Availability of up to 40 hours/week is preferred. This role will require some overlap with UTC-8:00 (2-5 hrs/day) America/Los_Angeles

title: Professor de inglês
description:
Faça parte da comunidade de professores que está transformando o ensino de idiomas no Brasil!


Onde os influencers do Brasil fazem suas aulas particulares!


A Idioma Independente , referência em inovação no ensino de idiomas, está buscando pessoas proativas, com perfil proativo e fluência em um segundo idioma, que querem ter sucesso no âmbito profissional, para se credenciar como professores e fazer parte da nossa comunidade engajada.


Aqui, você não será apenas mais um perfil online: você será parte de uma rede colaborativa com mais de 400 professores e 4.000 alunos que vivenciam nossa metodologia transformadora hoje, além de mais de 1000 professores e 10.000 alunos que já fizeram parte desta história.


Nos últimos 12 meses tivemos mais de 22 mil alunos interessados em fazer aulas conosco. Professores novos têm lotado suas agendas em até 30 dias, quando são comprometidos, se comunicam de forma eficaz e tem agenda no horário da noite disponível.

Como saber se você é a pessoa certa para fazer parte da maior comunidade de professores independentes do Brasil?


Se você tem grandes ambições para impactar a educação no Brasil, acredita que o ensino de idiomas precisa de inovação, quer otimizar sua agenda de aulas e, ainda, gostaria de crescer como empreendedor, este é o lugar certo para você.

  • Independência para executar atividades, espírito de colaboração e vontade de contribuir para uma comunidade.

Você será parte de uma comunidade de professores no ensino de idiomas , onde o trabalho colaborativo é a base para alcançar resultados de mercado altamente competitivos.


Esta não é uma vaga CLT , mas sim uma oportunidade de empreender e ser dono do seu crescimento com total suporte e estrutura de uma empresa inovadora.


Você cria laços e relações de confiança com pessoas que realmente se esforçam para te ajudar no seu desenvolvimento, devido ao modelo de negócio inovador que proporciona relações colaborativas e efetivas.


Se você tem vontade de fazer diferente e de vivenciar algo novo na sua história profissional, a ii com certeza é o seu lugar.


Faça parte da mudança no ensino de idiomas. Junte-se à Idioma Independente e transforme sua carreira e a vida de milhares de alunos!


O que eu faço?


  • Recebo capacitação para dar a melhor aula experimental da sua vida
  • Recebo capacitação em nossa metodologia, aprendendo como transformar a vida de muitos alunos, entregando resultado para eles/as
  • Recebo treinamentos e capacitações recorrentes com mentores experientes e especializados
  • Organizo e escolho a minha agenda e os horários que gostaria de ter alunos/as
  • Preparo aulas para os meus alunos/as

Se você quiser ir além, também será possível, basta você se engajar na comunidade e aprender mais sobre todas as áreas do seu negócio.


QUANTO EU RECEBO POR ISSO?

  • Se você realmente quiser crescer e se desenvolver, se dedicando de forma integral junto da comunidade é possível chegar até R$12.000,00 por mês em 2 anos.


Tudo isso só dependerá de você, se quiser aprender mais sobre as partes comerciais e sobre como se tornar um mentor/a de professores.


Seja diferente, seja independente

  • Git-based workflows: branching strategies, PR culture, code review

  • Hands-on experience with tools such as xUnit or NUnit and mocking libraries
  • Experience with integration testing approaches such as TestServer or similar
  • Familiarity with end-to-end testing tools such as Playwright is a plus
  • Ability to design meaningful test scenarios and prioritize quality over coverage metrics


AI-Assisted Development

  • Active use of AI coding tools such as GitHub Copilot, Cursor or similar in daily work
  • Strong prompt writing skills and ability to guide AI effectively
  • Experience using AI for code generation, refactoring, documentation and code review
  • Ability to critically evaluate AI-generated outputs and ensure code quality
  • Keeping up to date with evolving AI tools and applying them in development workflows


Building AI-Powered Features

  • Experience integrating LLM APIs into applications
  • Understanding of AI-driven workflows and agent-based systems
  • Familiarity with concepts such as RAG, semantic search or vector databases
  • Ability to evaluate AI outputs and design reliable user-facing features
  • Awareness of data privacy and security considerations when working with AI


Nice to Have

  • Azure AI services and monitoring tools
  • CI/CD pipeline experience
  • Experience in healthcare or regulated environments


Who You Are

  • You write clean and maintainable code
  • You take ownership and deliver end-to-end
  • You focus on building rather than discussing
  • You are curious, proactive and open to continuous learning


If you enjoy building real products and working with modern technologies, we would be happy to hear from you.

description:

We are seeking an experienced Senior C# Developer to join a collaborative engineering team focused on enhancing Portfolio Management capabilities.


This role will partner closely with engineering, trading, risk, and operations teams to design and deliver scalable, high-performance solutions that improve portfolio transparency, accuracy, and operational efficiency across the firm.   • Improve system performance, scalability, and reliability

  • Design and maintain robust APIs for internal consumers

- Collaboration & Leadership


  • Work closely with portfolio managers, traders, risk, and operations teams to translate business requirements into technical solutions
  • Collaborate within the engineering team to drive architectural improvements

  • Promote best practices in testing, CI/CD, monitoring, and observability


Mandatory Skills Description:

  • 7+ years of professional software development experience.

  • Exposure to multi-threaded programming concepts.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Strong team player.
  • Bachelor's degree in computer science or engineering.

  • Realizar workshops e treinamentos presenciais para parceiros e clientes;

title: Senior Business Analyst – Supply Chain
description:
Who We Are

We are an IFS integrator, providing end-to-end ERP implementation projects and exceptional support services. As strategic business partners, we collaborate with clients across key industries, helping them drive digital transformation.

Our global team of 200+ members brings extensive expertise, including former IFS customers who understand real-world operational challenges and dedicated IFS specialists with deep functional and technical knowledge. Together, we deliver outstanding services to reshape businesses and optimize supply chain operations.


Who We Are Looking For

We are currently seeking a Senior Business Analyst – Supply Chain , a client-facing leadership role responsible for driving complex ERP implementations within supply chain domains (procurement, inventory, logistics, planning, and distribution).

This role requires a strong functional expert who can lead requirement gathering, solution design, and implementation while acting as a key advisor to clients and an escalation point for junior analysts.

If you are passionate about supply chain optimization, ERP transformation, and leading cross-functional collaboration in global projects, we encourage you to apply.


Key Responsibilities

Business Requirements & Client Engagement

• Lead requirement gathering sessions with stakeholders across supply chain functions.

• Analyze business processes (procurement, inventory, warehousing, logistics) to identify improvements and optimization opportunities.

• Translate complex supply chain and technical concepts into clear language for non-technical stakeholders.

• Perform gap analysis between current operations and ERP capabilities, ensuring scalable and efficient solutions.

• Advise clients on best practices aligned with industry standards and digital transformation strategies.


Solution Design, Implementation & Testing

• Lead supply chain module implementation within ERP (IFS or similar).

• Supervise and mentor Business Analysts and Junior Analysts within the domain.

• Collaborate with Project Managers on planning, estimations, and risk mitigation.

• Work closely with development and technical teams to ensure accurate solution delivery.

• Lead design discussions to align system architecture with business objectives.

• Ensure quality assurance testing and validation of supply chain functionalities.

• Support cross-functional alignment with Solution Architects and other domains.

• Deliver user training sessions and create functional documentation to ensure adoption.


Training, Expertise & Continuous Improvement (20%)

• Act as a Subject Matter Expert (SME) in supply chain processes and ERP functionalities.

• Stay up to date with industry trends, including digital supply chain, automation, and best practices.

• Maintain relevant certifications (IFS or equivalent ERP modules).

• Drive continuous improvement initiatives across projects and internal practices.


Must Have

• Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain, Industrial Engineering, Business, or related field.

• Minimum 5 years of experience in supply chain processes (procurement, logistics, inventory, planning).

• Minimum 3 years in client-facing roles.

• Experience in ERP implementation projects (IFS preferred).

• Strong understanding of supply chain operations across industries such as Manufacturing, Energy, Construction, or Services.

• Fluent in Portuguese and English (Spanish or French is a plus).

• Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.

• Strong analytical thinking and problem-solving capabilities.

• Experience with project management and collaboration tools.

• Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Office.

• Availability to travel.

• Legally authorized to work in Brazil.


What We Offer

• Competitive salary and benefits package.

• Career growth opportunities with certifications and professional development.

• A collaborative and international work environment.

• Involvement in high-impact global supply chain transformation projects.


Why Hoist?

If you are looking for an opportunity to lead impactful supply chain transformations and grow your career in a dynamic and global environment, Hoist is the place for you.

Join our team and be part of a people-first culture that values collaboration, innovation, and professional growth.

  • Meios de Comunicação: Utilizamos E-mail e WhatsApp. Certifique-se de que essas informações estejam corretas no momento de inscrição para evitar falhas na comunicação.


O que buscamos?

Estamos em busca de um(a) Desenvolvedor(a) Back-end (Node.js e Java) para fazer parte do nosso movimento. Essa pessoa será responsável por desenvolver soluções robustas e escaláveis, atuando de ponta a ponta no ciclo de desenvolvimento, com forte interação com stakeholders e foco em qualidade técnica e inovação.


Como será seu dia-a-dia?

  • Analisar e compreender as necessidades e requisitos dos clientes, trabalhando em estreita colaboração com equipes internas e stakeholders para implementar soluções técnicas adequadas e inovadoras.
  • Desenvolver e documentar código de alta qualidade, seguindo padrões e melhores práticas de programação, utilizando frameworks e bibliotecas apropriadas para atender aos requisitos do projeto.
  • Participar do processo completo de desenvolvimento, desde o planejamento e análise até a programação, testes e implantação, garantindo a entrega de soluções funcionais e escaláveis.
  • Colaborar com outros desenvolvedores, arquitetos e gerentes de projeto, compartilhando conhecimento e ajudando a solucionar problemas e encontrar soluções inovadoras.
  • Comunicar-se efetivamente com os membros da equipe e stakeholders do projeto, fornecendo atualizações de progresso, discutindo desafios e soluções.
  • Participar de revisões de código e reuniões de equipe, contribuindo para a melhoria contínua dos processos e práticas de desenvolvimento.
  • Manter-se atualizado(a) sobre as tendências do setor e desenvolvimentos tecnológicos, aplicando esse conhecimento no aprimoramento das soluções e na promoção da inovação contínua.


Para cumprir esse desafio, você precisa ter:

  • Domínio sólido da linguagem de programação Node.js (TypeScript), com experiência em desenvolvimento de aplicativos em ambientes empresariais.
  • Conhecimento e experiência com frameworks e bibliotecas Node.js populares, como Express, Koa, NestJS, Mocha, Jest e outras.
  • Familiaridade com desenvolvimento de aplicações web utilizando HTML, CSS, TypeScript/JavaScript e AJAX.
  • Experiência com sistemas de gerenciamento de banco de dados como MySQL, PostgreSQL, Oracle ou SQL Server, e habilidades em SQL e modelagem de dados.
  • Conhecimento de práticas e padrões de desenvolvimento de software, como SOLID, design patterns e metodologias ágeis (Scrum ou Kanban).
  • Habilidade em escrever e executar testes unitários e de integração, utilizando ferramentas como Mocha, Jest ou similares.
  • Familiaridade com IDEs como Visual Studio Code ou WebStorm e sistemas de controle de versão como Git.
  • Conhecimento de práticas de segurança e conformidade no desenvolvimento de software.
  • Experiência com integração de APIs e serviços de terceiros via REST, SOAP ou gRPC.
  • Capacidade de analisar e solucionar problemas de desempenho e escalabilidade, aplicando técnicas de otimização e monitoramento.


Você irá se destacar se:

  • Tiver vivência com práticas de DevOps, CI/CD e containerização com Docker/Kubernetes.

title: Full-Stack Senior PHP Developer
description:
Are you passionate about building enterprise grade software applications that people depend on? Do you care that your work makes life better for people around the world? 


We’re building a Latam based fullstack software engineering team to scale and enhance our award winning cloud-based educational technology platform. After establishing a strong product with a fully remote U.S. team while 2xing revenue year over year, we’re now looking for the inaugural elite members to build and grow our Latam team. 


Consider this a unique opportunity to work with a U.S. based product company of top engineers and product executives, make an impact by improving education, and be part of a rocket ship!


About You


  • Versatile and hands-on doer, starter attitude
  • Empathetic and humble, you are respectful, optimistic, have the capacity to commit to disagreement when needed, and take ownership
  • Ability and willingness to work cross-functionally
  • Experience working with non-tech colleagues


Core Responsibilities


  • Develop PHP based features end to end
  • Address complex refactoring challenges in legacy PHP systems
  • Debug and repair broken or overly buggy code
  • Contribute to code reviews, QA, and an Agile development process
  • Participate in architectural planning and technical roadmapping


Must Have


  • 3+ years building full-stack applications with PHP backend
  • English Fluency
  • Experience writing front end JavaScript
  • Experience with SQL
  • API development expertise
  • Collaborative mindset with ability to work independently
  • Growth-oriented approach


Nice to Have


  • Modern PHP framework knowledge such as Laravel
  • Component-based JS framework experience
  • Cloud deployments experience
  • Test automation experience
  • Microservices development experience
  • Educational software or SaaS platforms expertise
  • Data integration expertise
  • Enthusiastic about learning and teaching others


What You’ll Get


An opportunity for uncommonly fast career growth. Work in a supportive, collaborative, and creative environment where you can thrive personally and professionally


  • Above market salary in local market
  • Flexible PTO and vacation policy
  • Flexible, family-friendly schedule to help you achieve work/life balance
  • Exposure to the US education technology industry
  • Exposure to industry C-suite executives and valuable networking experiences
  • Team up alongside a group of down to earth people looking to level up and build something big
  • Full-time remote position


We are an equal opportunity employer. No recruiters, please.


— FAQ —


What would be my career trajectory?


As a company, we have a very flat hierarchy. Your direct manager will be the VP of Engineering and his boss the Co-founder and Chief Product Officer. If you care about building experience by cultivating high-functioning teams, releasing great software, accomplishing goals, and learning new things, this is the right place for you. If you care about titles and meetings and titles, this is not the right place for you. Our belief is there will always be “the next job” so push yourself to learn and grow in the time you are here.


What is work like here?


We’re a Series B funded education technology platform. Think of us as a startup but without all of the early stage business and funding risks. It also means no corporate atmosphere with a strict dress code, and no stuffy bureaucracy to drown out your ideas. We value every team member and if we hire you, it’s because we think you can do great things with us. We aren’t going to sugar-coat everything. We have our challenges like every other business. Where we separate ourselves is having the willingness and motivation to take our challenges head-on before they grow.

title: Email Graphic Designer
description:
Company Description

IM Digital is a forward-thinking commerce consultancy dedicated to helping world-class brands build their digital foundation, optimize operations, and drive revenue growth. Through innovative strategies, the company creates value with speed and scale, ensuring clients are equipped to navigate an ever-evolving digital landscape. As a trusted partner, IM Digital provides expert guidance and solutions to accelerate success.


About the Role

We are looking for a Email Graphic Designer to lead and elevate creative execution across our Retention & Lifecycle Marketing team. This role is ideal for a highly skilled designer who not only produces exceptional email creative but also drives efficiency through design systems, mentors junior talent, and contributes to broader marketing storytelling through high-impact visual content.


You will play a key role in shaping how brands communicate with their customers across email and lifecycle channels—while also extending creative into thought leadership assets such as case studies, one-pagers, and slide decks used across and other marketing channels.


As part of our Creative Guild , you’ll collaborate with cross-functional creative leaders across UI/UX, branding, and digital experience to continuously evolve our standards and capabilities.

What You'll Do

  • Lead the design and execution of high-performing email campaigns and automated lifecycle programs across multiple clients

  • Develop polished one-pagers, case studies, and presentation decks for use in marketing, sales, and thought leadership (e.g., , blog content)
  • Own and evolve email design systems , including reusable components, templates, and documentation to improve speed and consistency
  • Collaborate closely with strategists, campaign managers, developers, and other creatives to deliver best-in-class lifecycle experiences
  • Oversee the preparation and handoff of designs in Figma for seamless implementation across platforms
  • Incorporate and optimize AI-driven workflows (e.g., generative imagery, copy, and layout exploration)
  • Configure and refine AI agents to generate content aligned with brand voice and creative standards
  • Analyze creative performance and iterate based on insights to continuously improve results
  • Manage multiple projects and timelines across a portfolio of clients

Leadership & Mentorship

  • Mentor and provide guidance to Junior Email Graphic Designers , supporting skill development and creative quality
  • Conduct design reviews and provide constructive, actionable feedback
  • Help establish and uphold creative best practices across the team
  • Contribute to onboarding and training materials for new creative team members

What We're Looking For

  • 4+ years of experience in email design, digital design, or lifecycle marketing creative
  • Advanced proficiency in Figma and strong command of design systems and component-based design
  • Proven ability to create visually compelling marketing assets beyond email (e.g., decks, case studies, one-pagers)
  • Strong understanding of layout, typography, hierarchy, and conversion-focused design principles
  • Experience working in fast-paced, client-facing or agency environments
  • Excellent communication, collaboration, and time management skills
  • Ability to balance creative vision with performance-driven outcomes

Are you a Portuguese speaker who graduated as an English Teacher? We are looking for you!

Teach fun English classes online via Zoom from the comfort of your own home! You can set your own hours and teach on the go as long as you have a solid color backdrop, a laptop, good WiFi, a webcam, and a microphone.


If you love teaching, but dread prepping for lessons and grading, this is the perfect job for you. We provide our teachers with all the lesson materials so all you have to do is show up for class and do what you do best, which is teach!

Whether you’re looking for a second stream of income or a full-time job, we’ve got you covered. You can work as little as 16 hours a month up to as much as 30 hours a week.


What is a typical day for an Online English Teacher at LatinHire?

You will be scheduled shifts two weeks in advance according to the availability you provide us and we also offer the flexibility of dropping shifts and picking up extra shifts.

If you are busier one week, you can drop some of your shifts and have other teachers help you out or if you want to earn more $$ another week, you can pick up extra shifts and help other teachers out.

When you are on shift, you log on to our platform and teach the lessons provided as well as write short feedback for the students after class. Simple as that!


In short, here are some reasons why you will love working as an Online English Teacher with LatinHire:


  • Up to 30 hours of shifts available per week!
  • You be your own boss and set your own schedule
  • Work from anywhere (as long as you have good WiFi, workspace, computer, webcam, and microphone).

Minimum Requirements:


  • Portuguese as a first language.

Established in 2003, LatinHire recruits and manages teams of subject matter experts (SMEs) for online education companies. For over 20 years, our teams have played key roles in the backend of very successful educational startups.

title: Technical Product Owner
description:
ABOUT US

Syniti , part of Capgemini, tackles the hardest work in data for the world’s largest organizations. We combine intelligent software with deep data expertise to help the Fortune2000 tackle complex data challenges and drive measurable business outcomes with business-ready data.

Syniti’s Data First strategy transforms data from an afterthought into a strategic asset—unlocking insights, reducing risk, and fueling growth. With over 5,000 successful projects, we support the full data lifecycle through a unified platform for migration, quality, replication, matching, master data management, analytics, governance, and strategy.

Operating globally across industries, Syniti’s award-winning software, expert consultants give enterprises a unique edge in managing and maximizing their data.


Syniti’s cloud-native platform sets new standards in enterprise data management, combining powerful SaaS solutions with deep domain expertise. Designed for agility and scale, our technology helps customers accelerate digital transformation, drive innovation, and make confident decisions with trusted data. Every product enhancement is built to solve real business challenges—empowering organizations to unlock value from their data faster and more effectively.


THE ROLE

We are seeking a highly technical and execution‑driven Technical Product Owner to serve as the “engine room” of our platform. In this role, you will translate high‑level product strategy into clear, actionable, and technically sound work for engineering teams. You will bridge complex legacy ERP architectures (SAP S/4HANA, ECC) with modern, cloud‑native, AI‑driven workflows across the Syniti Knowledge Platform. This role goes far beyond writing tickets — we are looking for someone who uses AI for deep research, builds mockup screens to define user journeys, and ensures the creation of the “Golden Record” through seamless end‑to‑end integration across cataloging, migration, quality, and governance.



What You’ll Do

  • Product Ownership & Agile Execution: Lead 2–3 scrum teams by owning and prioritizing the backlog for key SKP capabilities (Migrate, Replicate, Drive, Orchestrate). Run high-impact backlog grooming, sprint planning, and estimation sessions.
  • Modern Requirement Engineering: Translate strategy into crisp Epics and User Stories. Use AI-driven tools to accelerate documentation, explore ERP integration patterns, and generate edge-case test scenarios.
  • UX & Workflow Prototyping: Design mockups and wireframes (Figma, v0, Miro) to visualize data journeys. Ensure that both Data Stewards and Developers experience intuitive, world‑class workflows within SKP.
  • Lifecycle Integration: Partner with Architecture and Engineering to define functional and non‑functional requirements (scalability, security). Ensure seamless integration across the entire data lifecycle to eliminate duplication and unlock full platform value.
  • Quality & Acceptance: Collaborate with the PXQ team to define “What Good Looks Like.” Act as the final validation gate to ensure features meet enterprise standards and align with real‑world user behavior.
  • Operational Feedback Loop: Engage with Support and Customer Success to funnel production learnings into the backlog, ensuring continuous improvement based on real customer usage.



WHAT IT TAKES

  • The Technical Veteran: 5+ years as a Product Owner or Business Analyst working on enterprise data products. Strong understanding of data integration, replication, APIs, and cloud-native architectures (AWS/Azure).
  • The ERP Expert: Deep experience with SAP ecosystems and large-scale transformation programs. Understanding of MDM, Data Quality, and Governance “plumbing.” Experience with SAP MDG or Informatica is a major plus.
  • The Modern Builder: An AI-native thinker who uses LLMs to enhance productivity and research. Prefers mockups over long documents and thrives in visual communication.
  • The Agile Leader: CSPO-certified with demonstrated ability to manage risks, dependencies, and scope changes across distributed, multi-time‑zone teams.
  • The Academic: Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or related practical experience.
  • The Communicator: Able to clearly articulate complex data and replication logic to business users while also explaining product vision to engineering teams.


Key Skills

  • Visionary Leadership: Ability to maintain a clear product vision, define objectives, and mentor teams toward business goals.
  • Advanced Governance Concepts: Strong command of data management and governance principles, including hierarchy and survivorship rules.
  • AI/ML Application: Experience using AI/ML tools for documentation automation, market trend analysis, and optimization of data‑matching or data‑cleansing logic.
  • Visual Communication: Skilled at producing wireframes and process flows to ensure UX alignment.
  • Technical Storyboarding: Ability to write precise user stories and acceptance criteria with zero ambiguity.
  • Relationship Orchestration: Strong interpersonal skills to influence stakeholders and drive collaborative engagement.
  • Drive for Results: Relentless focus on delivering incremental value and ensuring release readiness in a fast‑moving environment.


Be fully aligned with our core values:

Think Big - Be courageous and bold. Aspire to greatness. Relentlessly pursue market innovation. Set the standard by which others follow. Create solutions that have a meaningful impact. Solve the challenges our customers don’t know they have.

Be Curious - Be a lifelong learner. Seek out new ideas to serve customers. Understand our competition and the world. Be permanently dissatisfied with the status quo. Challenge preconceptions. Focus on the future rather than yesterday.

Take Action - Be the first. Don’t wait. Take accountability. Inspire others by doing. Fail fast and learn from mistakes. Make a difference every day.

Stronger Together - Respect, trust and look out for each other. Celebrate diverse perspectives. Listen. Build connections and belonging. Act with integrity. Give back. One Syniti family.

Operational Oversight

title: Software Engineer Sênior
description:
A abertura atual é para a Artefact do Brasil, mas estamos em modelo Free Office.
Quem nós somos

Um ambiente de trabalho saudável é um lugar onde todas as vozes são ouvidas, respeitadas e valorizadas.

Temos como nosso compromisso a construção de um ambiente mais diverso e inclusivo, porque a empatia é para todas as pessoas, independentemente de etnia, cor, gênero, orientação sexual, identidade de gênero, deficiência ou crença religiosa.

Como Software Engineer Sênior na Artefact, você será uma peça-chave do nosso time de tecnologia, contribuindo ativamente para o desenho, desenvolvimento e evolução de aplicações web complexas que apoiam nossos projetos de dados e insights em múltiplas indústrias.
Você atuará em colaboração com equipes de Data Engineering, Data Science e Consultoria Analítica, garantindo que as soluções sejam escaláveis, seguras e integradas às necessidades reais dos nossos clientes. Além de desenvolver, você será referência técnica, ajudando a definir padrões e boas práticas dentro da equipe.

  • Colaborar com equipes multidisciplinar :  transformando modelos e algoritmos de dados em soluções visuais e produtos interativos.      
  • Definir arquitetura de software e padrões técnicos, promovendo boas práticas de DevOps, CI/CD , testes automatizados e versionamento (Git, Docker, Kubernetes).
  • Mentorar desenvolvedores de diferentes níveis, promovendo crescimento técnico e colaboração.

  • Formação: Graduação em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia de Software ou curso na área correlata.      
  • Experiência solida (+5 anos):  em desenvolvimento web com React, Next.js, JavaScript e TypeScript.     
  • Domínio em bancos de dados SQL e NoSQL , com habilidade em modelagem, otimização de queries e performance.      
  • Vivência avançada em nuvem (Azure, AWS ou GCP) , incluindo autenticação, pipelines, integração de serviços e observabilidade.
  • Experiência prática com DevOps e CI/CD , uso de Docker , Kubernetes e ferramentas de integração contínua.
  • Visão arquitetural e capacidade de tomar decisões técnicas estratégicas.  
  • Inglês fluente (para interação com equipes e clientes internacionais).


O que oferecemos;       

  • VR/VT       
  • Free office (trabalhe de casa ou de onde quiser!)       
  • Gympass       
  • Seguros: Vida, saúde e odontológico       
  • Encontros Bimestrais (Famoso “Get Together” onde nos encontramos para estarmos juntos, com oficinas, palestras, treinamentos e aquele happy hour!)       
  • Woba (pode marcar para trabalhar em coworking onde quiser!)      
  • Avaliações semestrais (com oportunidade de promoção)       

Por que você deveria se juntar a nós;       

  • Artefact é o lugar para estar: venha e construa o futuro da tecnologia de dados       
  • Progresso: cada dia oferece novos desafios e novas oportunidades de aprender       
  • Cultura: junte-se à melhor equipe que você poderia imaginar       
  • Empreendedorismo: você se juntará a uma equipe de empreendedores motivados. Não desistiremos até que façamos uma grande diferença nesta indústria!       

Junte-se a nós!

Desenvolver e implantar fluxos de LLM para o ecossistema ERP Protheus, transformando dados complexos em soluções de negócio escaláveis.

  • Engenharia de Software: Aplicar boas práticas de desenvolvimento, incluindo Clean Code e versionamento de código via Git;


REQUISITOS E QUALIFICAÇÕES

  • Desenvolver agentes inteligentes (LangGraph / LangChain);

  • produção;


DIFERENCIAL

  • Conhecimento em Regressão, Classificação, Clustering, Séries Temporais, Redes Neurais;
  • Garantir a qualidade técnica e a governança estatística dos modelos implantados;
  • Boas práticas de engenharia de software: CleanCode, Versionamento de Código (Git).

title: Senior Analytics Engineer
description:
Company Description

United Hub Digital (UHD) is a nearshore IT consulting firm helping mid and large US enterprise clients accelerate their data and technology initiatives. Headquartered in Greenville, SC, with a delivery hub in Brazil, we embed directly into client teams as a trusted execution partner across data analytics, software development, UI/UX, and project management. We hold ourselves to the same standards of accountability and delivery quality our clients expect from their own teams.


About the Role

We are looking for a Senior Analytics Engineer to help one of our enterprise clients unlock the value of their data for AI-driven use cases. The goal focus for this role is to 'make the data AI-ready': well-structured, semantically rich, documented, and governed.

Your primary output is a clean, well-documented, and semantically meaningful data environment that downstream AI workloads can reason over reliably.

------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

What You Will Do

Semantic Modeling

  • Design and build semantic layers that translate raw ERP tables into business-meaningful domains (finance, procurement, supply chain, etc.)
  • Define and enforce naming conventions, metric definitions, and business logic in a shared, governed layer
  • Work with Databricks semantic layer to expose curated datasets for AI and analytics consumption


Data Documentation and Context

  • Produce column-level documentation, data dictionaries, and business glossaries inside Unity Catalog
  • Establish lineage tracing from source system tables through to consumption-ready datasets
  • Collaborate with source systems stakeholders to capture domain knowledge and translate it into structured metadata


AI Readiness

  • Structure data to support LLM-based and ML workloads, including RAG pipelines and structured querying
  • Identify and address data quality gaps that would undermine AI model reliability
  • Define thematic data domains and organize datasets to give AI systems the right context and scope


Governance and Quality

  • Implement data quality rules and freshness monitors using Databricks tooling
  • Tag sensitive fields and support data access tier definitions within Unity Catalog
  • Own documentation standards and ensure the catalog remains accurate as data evolves

------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Qualifications

Required

  • 5+ years in analytics engineering, data architecture, or a closely related discipline
  • Hands-on Databricks expertise: Unity Catalog, Delta Lake, cluster configuration, and query optimization
  • Experience with semantic modeling tools, ideally dbt (dbt Core or dbt Cloud)
  • Strong SQL and a solid understanding of data modeling patterns (star schema, medallion architecture, etc.)
  • Ability to read and interpret unfamiliar data models quickly, including ERP-sourced data structures
  • Experience writing technical documentation that non-technical stakeholders can act on


Nice to Have

  • Exposure to Databricks AI/BI, Genie, or Vector Search
  • Experience supporting ML or LLM-based downstream use cases
  • Background in data mesh or domain-oriented data architecture

title: Tech Lead Ruby on Rails
description:
Grupo Smart Fit, a força que ativa o seu potencial.

O Grupo Smart Fit é a maior plataforma de fitness e bem-estar da América Latina e um dos grupos que mais crescem no mundo. Trabalhar no Grupo Smart Fit é levar na carreira a força de um grande grupo global, com visão de longo prazo, estrutura robusta e oportunidades reais de crescimento, mobilidade entre marcas e novos desafios ao longo da jornada.

Tudo isso em uma cultura de alta performance, forte, colaborativa e conectada ao nosso propósito. Nosso ecossistema reúne marcas que atuam em diferentes frentes do fitness e bem-estar: academias como Smart Fit, Bio Ritmo e Nation CT; studios como Race Bootcamp, Vidya Studio, Jab House, Tonus Gym, Aera Pilates, Velocity e Kore; e produtos digitais, TotalPass e Queima Diária.


Principais responsabilidades:

1. Liderança Técnica e Arquitetura

  • Guardião da Base de Código: Definir e zelar pelos padrões de código (\"The Rails Way\"), garantindo que a API seja sólida para os projetos Web e Mobile.
  • Tomada de Decisão Técnica: Escolher as melhores tecnologias, bibliotecas e padrões que equilibrem rapidez de entrega com sustentabilidade futura.
  • Apoio à Gestão: Ser o braço direito do Gerente de TI e do GP, ajudando na estimativa de prazos, viabilidade de features e priorização técnica do backlog.


2. Qualidade, Integração e Homologação

  • Garantia de Eficiência no Processo: Homologar as integrações da API com os times de Front-end (Web e Mobile), garantindo que os contratos de dados sejam cumpridos e a performance seja máxima.
  • Revisão de Código (Code Review): Liderar as revisões de código dos parceiros, assegurando que nenhum débito técnico crítico entre em produção.
  • Estratégia de Testes: Definir a política de cobertura de testes e garantir que o time utilize mocks e ferramentas como VCR para manter a agilidade no desenvolvimento.


3. Sustentação, Suporte e Performance

  • Atendimento de Chamados Nível 3: Atuar como ponto focal em problemas complexos de produção, realizando a análise de causa raiz e orientando o time na correção definitiva.
  • Otimização Contínua: Monitorar gargalos de performance no servidor e no banco de dados, implementando melhorias proativas para suportar o crescimento do app.


4. Aprendizado e Melhoria Contínua

  • Radar Tecnológico: Manter o time atualizado com as novas versões do Ruby e do Rails, avaliando quando migrar ou adotar novas práticas.
  • Cultura de Inovação Pragmática: Estimular o uso de ferramentas de IA para ganho de produtividade, sem abrir mão da segurança e da qualidade do código.


O que buscamos

Pessoas que:

  • Dominem Arquitetura de Sistemas com Ruby on Rails: Domínio profundo de Rails em modo API e Monolitos, com habilidade para desenhar arquiteturas escaláveis, modulares e de fácil manutenção.
  • Têm experiência com Design de APIs e Contratos: Expertise em arquitetura RESTful, versionamento e, principalmente, na definição de contratos de dados que atendam de forma eficiente Web e Mobile.
  • Têm experiência com Engenharia de Testes Avançada: Domínio total de RSpec, incluindo estratégias complexas de mocking com VCR e WebMock, garantindo pipelines de CI/CD rápidos e determinísticos.
  • Têm experiência com Modelagem e Performance de Dados: Maestria em PostgreSQL, otimização de queries, gestão de índices e estratégias de cache (Redis) para suportar aplicações de alta performance.
  • Têm experiência com Segurança e Infraestrutura: Conhecimento sólido em protocolos de segurança (OAuth2, JWT), além de familiaridade com Docker e ambientes de deploy (AWS/Heroku/DigitalOcean).
  • Adotem estrategicamente a IA: Capacidade de liderar o time no uso eficiente de ferramentas como GitHub Copilot ou Cursor para acelerar a geração de código, testes e documentação.
  • Tenham pragmatismo e visão de Negócio: Foco em entregar a melhor solução técnica que respeite os prazos e objetivos da empresa, evitando \"overengineering\".
  • Tenham Liderança e Mentoria: Capacidade de elevar o nível técnico dos devs Plenos e Juniores através de Code Reviews educativos e suporte constante.
  • Tenham Comunicação Estratégica e Proativa: Habilidade de traduzir requisitos de negócio (GP) em tarefas técnicas e alinhar expectativas com os times de Front/Mobile para evitar bloqueios.
  • Têm experiência com Gestão de Crises e Decisão: Calma e assertividade para tomar decisões técnicas difíceis sob pressão e resolver incidentes críticos em produção.
  • Tenham Atitude de Dono: Comprometimento total com a qualidade do produto final, antecipando gargalos e propondo melhorias antes que se tornem problemas.

Architect data pipelines in collaboration with Data Engineers to curate high-quality synthetic data and improve model training efficiency.
Solve complex 'hallucination' problems by serving as the final escalation point for enhancing model factuality and designing logic for retrievers and re-rankers.
Mentor the team by translating the latest research papers into actionable engineering tickets.
Qualification Required
Extensive experience with Py Torch and the Hugging Face ecosystem (Transformers, PEFT, Accelerate).
Proven track record of fine-tuning models, with a deep understanding of attention mechanisms, positional embeddings, and transformer architectures.
Hands-on experience with vector databases (Pinecone, Milvus) and familiarity with the mathematics behind similarity search and embedding models.
Proficiency in Python, along with familiarity in containerization (Docker) and cloud-scale Al training (AWS Sage Maker/GCP Vertex Al).
Ability to analyze model failures, hypothesize root causes, and systematically test solutions.
Nice to Have
Advanced Degree: A Master's or Ph D in Computer Science, Math, or a related field with a focus on NLP.
Multi-Modal Experience: Familiarity with Vision-Language Models (VLM) or audio-to-text integration.
Reinforcement Learning: Experience with RLHF (Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback) or DPO (Direct Preference Optimization).
Open Source Presence: A portfolio of public Git Hub repos, Hugging Face models, or published papers in the Gen Al space.
Hardware Knowledge: Deep understanding of NVIDIA GPU architectures (H100/A100) and CUDA kernels to maximize hardware utilization.

Our client is a people-focused organization dedicated to developing impactful products and services that create meaningful value for customers and communities. title: Landholder and reforestation delivery manager
description:
About Nature Co
Nature Co delivers nature-based solutions (Nb S) for investors, corporates and other purpose driven organisations to scale up action on climate change and biodiversity loss. We specialise in nature-based project development including reforestation, agroforestry, farmer managed natural regeneration and mangrove restoration. Nature Co has extensive expertise in working with local communities to protect and restore natural ecosystems through participation in the global voluntary carbon market.
Nature Co is currently implementing a large-scale reforestation project in Brazil for the generation of verified carbon credits.
We are a diverse, mission-driven team that values inclusion, integrity, and innovation. Nature Co is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer, committed to building an equitable and inclusive workplace for all.
Role and responsibilities
The Landholder and Reforestation Delivery Manager is the primary field-based interface with landholders, communities, reforestation contractors, and other local stakeholders for Nature Co's projects in Brazil. This position will build and manage a pipeline of landholders interested in reforestation, lead outreach and onboarding, coordinate site inspections, lead the collection of relevant data required for carbon standard checks, and lead signature of landholder agreements. The role will also play a key role in ensuring compliance (contracts and carbon standards) as well as coordinate schedules between landholders and contractors for the implementation of reforestation activities. This will include confirming site readiness, conducting periodic field quality audits, documenting and tracking progress, and resolving issues that could delay delivery or degrade quality.
The role requires a strong combination stakeholder engagement and management experience, and a commitment to quality and impact. The role requires extensive travel and field work across Minas Gerais, Bahia and Espírito Santo.
Primary roles and responsibilities include:
Landholder engagement, onboarding, and pipeline management
Map priority municipalities and referral partner networks (city governments, co-ops, farmer associations, NGOs); plan and run outreach activities, events and information sessions.
Manage the landholder onboarding process (identify → qualify → onboard → contract), using CRM/trackers to keep status, documents and next actions current.
Prepare clear information packs (benefits, obligations, timelines) and respond to inquiries in a timely, professional manner.
Maintain ongoing landholder relationship management to support retention, satisfaction, and smooth site access throughout implementation. Eligibility, due diligence & agreements
Coordinate site inspections and initial diagnostics in consultation with other team members (parcel boundaries, vegetation status, access, water, risks).
Support land tenure verification and FPIC documentation
Lead closure of contract signatures.
Maintain organized repository of all landholder records within Nature Co's data management system (land titles, eligibility documents, contracts, site maps, inspection notes, photos, consultation records).
Reforestation delivery enablement
Translate signed landholder agreements into implementation-ready site plans (site-specific scope, access instructions, constraints, schedule windows).
Align field schedules with landholders and contractors to ensure access, minimize disruption to farm activities, and maintain trust and cooperation.
Support in the delivery of field delivery progress from contractors by site (start/finish dates, activities completed, challenges, next steps), and escalate issues early (access, weather delays, input shortages, labor constraints).
Support in monitoring reforestation activities (during and post planting) and coordinate, where required, rapid response with contractors/landholders (grazing, fire risk, pests, drought stress). Stakeholder engagement and safeguards
Plan and document stakeholder consultations and community meetings in accordance with Nature Co policies and procedures (agendas, attendance lists, minutes, photos).
Support the team in the operation of the grievance mechanism: receiving grievances and responding in accordance with the Nature Co grievance mechanism.
Maintain landholder contact and ensure landholder information is kept up to date.
Coordinate access, for other project staff and contractors as required. Reporting
Lead or assist the development of formal monthly, quarterly, and annual project implementation reports for internal and external stakeholders in line with contract and/or carbon standard requirements.
Prepare ad hoc reports, documents, and presentations for internal and external stakeholders. Teamwork and culture
Support the management of a cross-functional, international team, fostering collaboration and ensuring that project milestones and goals are met.
Stay current on emerging best practices in Nb S and carbon projects; proactively share insights across the organisation and with partners. Skills and attributes
To perform successfully in this role, you will have:
A minimum of five (5) years of experience in reforestation projects with direct contact with rural landholders and reforestation planting service providers.
Degree in forest engineering, agronomy, ecology, or environmental science.
Intermediate English and native Portuguese language skills
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to engage confidently across cultures and stakeholder groups.
Strong project management skills, including experience managing timelines, deliverables, and working across multidisciplinary teams.
A proactive, self-starting approach with the ability to anticipate problems, adapt quickly, and take initiative under limited supervision.
A collaborative mindset and ability to lead and motivate internal teams and external partners
Ability to provide strategic and technical guidance across complex, multi-stakeholder projects.
Strong organisational skills and attention to detail in documentation and reporting.
A positive, energetic personality with resilience and drive to see projects through to delivery. Extensive travel within Brazil is a requirement to perform this position.
Location
Remote, with residence in Minas Gerais, Espirito Santo, or Bahia Submission instructions
Email CV and brief cover letter to with subject: Landholder and Reforestation Delivery Manager
Submission deadline: 30 March 2026

title: English teacher
description:
Are you a Portuguese speaker who graduated as an English Teacher? We are looking for you!
Teach fun English classes online via Zoom from the comfort of your own home! You can set your own hours and teach on the go as long as you have a solid color backdrop, a laptop, good Wi Fi, a webcam, and a microphone.
If you love teaching, but dread prepping for lessons and grading, this is the perfect job for you. We provide our teachers with all the lesson materials so all you have to do is show up for class and do what you do best, which is teach!
Whether you're looking for a second stream of income or a full-time job, we've got you covered. You can work as little as 16 hours a month up to as much as 30 hours a week.

You will be scheduled shifts two weeks in advance according to the availability you provide us and we also offer the flexibility of dropping shifts and picking up extra shifts.
If you are busier one week, you can drop some of your shifts and have other teachers help you out or if you want to earn more $$ another week, you can pick up extra shifts and help other teachers out.
When you are on shift, you log on to our platform and teach the lessons provided as well as write short feedback for the students after class. Simple as that!
In short, here are some reasons why you will love working as an Online English Teacher with Latin Hire:
Up to 30 hours of shifts available per week!
You be your own boss and set your own schedule
Work from anywhere (as long as you have good Wi Fi, workspace, computer, webcam, and microphone).
Depending on the number of hours you decide to teach and on your schedule, you can earn up to USD 900+ per month. Minimum Requirements:
Portuguese as a first language.
C1 or C2 Level English Speaker
University degree in English Teaching or related area.
One year of experience in teaching English as a foreign language.
Access to a computer with a reliable, high-speed (at least 2 MB) internet connection.
Must pass a criminal background check.
Teachers must provide at least ten (10) hours of weekly availability. Who we are:
Established in 2003, Latin Hire recruits and manages teams of subject matter experts (SMEs) for online education companies. For over 20 years, our teams have played key roles in the backend of very successful educational startups.

title: Product owner
description:
Product Owner – Client Onboarding & Customer Success
Remote (Brazil-based) | Supporting UK & US stakeholders | 8,000 - 10,000 BRL
We're proud to be partnering with an innovative, fast-growing Saa S business that is transforming how organisations deliver professional online auction experiences under their own brand. Following a period of impressive growth, our client is now looking to appoint a Product Owner – Client Onboarding & Customer Success to play a pivotal role in their next phase.
This is a unique opportunity to sit at the intersection of product, clients, and operations—owning the journey from signed deal through to successful platform adoption.
The Opportunity
As Product Owner, you'll take the lead in ensuring new clients are seamlessly onboarded and set up for success from day one. Working closely with senior leadership, engineering, and customer success, you'll help clients quickly reach their first live auction and build long-term confidence using the platform.
This is a hands-on, highly collaborative role where you'll:
Guide clients through onboarding and implementation
Translate real-world client needs into clear product requirements
Support ongoing customer success and operational excellence
Play a key role in product testing and continuous improvement What You'll Be Doing
Owning the end-to-end onboarding journey from sales handover to go-live
Acting as a trusted partner to clients, supporting early use and best practice
Gathering and defining technical and operational requirements
Collaborating with engineering to ensure smooth configuration and delivery
Testing new features and ensuring releases are client-ready
Feeding real client insight back into the product roadmap What We're Looking For
Experience as a Product Owner, Product Manager, or Saa S Implementation specialist
A strong track record in customer success, onboarding, or client-facing roles
Ability to translate client needs into structured product requirements
Comfortable working cross-functionally with technical and non-technical teams
Highly organised, proactive, and confident managing multiple stakeholders
Exposure to B2 B Saa S, Agile environments, or platform-based products would be highly advantageous. Why Apply?
Join a scaling, globally-focused Saa S business at an exciting stage of growth
Work directly with an experienced and passionate leadership team
Have real influence over product direction and client success
Fully remote role with international collaboration
Be instrumental in shaping how clients experience and succeed with the platform If you're a product-minded professional who thrives on solving real client problems and driving meaningful outcomes, we'd love to hear from you.

title: Strategic partnership & alliance
description:
About Rate Gain
Rate Gain Travel Technologies Limited is a global provider of AI-powered Saa S solutions for travel and hospitality that works with 3,200+ customers and 700+ partners in 100+ countries helping them accelerate revenue generation through acquisition, retention, and wallet share expansion. Rate Gain today is one of the world's largest processors of electronic transactions, price points, and travel intent data helping revenue management, distribution and marketing teams across hotels, airlines, meta-search companies, package providers, car rentals, travel management companies, cruises and ferries drive better outcomes for their business.
Founded in 2004 and headquartered in India, today Rate Gain works with 26 of the Top 30 Hotel Chains, 25 of the Top 30 Online Travel Agents, 4 of the Top 5 Airlines, and all the top car rentals, including 16 Global Fortune 500 companies in unlocking new revenue every day.
Exploring the role
Rate Gain is privileged to partner with hotels of every size and type around the world to achieve their commercial objectives – from independent, luxury, lifestyle, and boutique hotels, to the world's largest chains. Chains - and multi-site operators - have unique business requirements, additional complexity, and often use more diverse technology solutions. As a partner of choice for global and regional chains, Rate Gain is looking to further serve this important segment of the hospitality industry and seeks an experienced Director focused on European markets, to further scale this essential unit of our business.
The ideal candidate will understand how Latam hotel chains function and operate, and will be familiar with the technology solutions adopted by these chains to achieve their commercial objectives. The role requires a trusted advisor, able to assist chains to manage through the complexities of the travel technology eco system to guide them to the right decisions in the areas of distribution, business intelligence, marketing technologies, and beyond.
This is an individual contributor role and, as such, the candidate is expected to be a self-started and self-driven, ready to innovate to find new values for our hotel chain clients whilst keeping the company goals and the bigger picture firmly in mind. This position can be based anywhere in Latam and needs to have the ability to travel within the Latam without limitations.
How your day will look like/Job responsibility
Build and manage strategic alliances with regional and local partners (e.g. RMS, PMS, booking engines, OTAs)
Define and execute a partnership roadmap aligned with Rate Gain's GTM strategy in LATAM
Identify co-marketing, co-selling, and integration opportunities with key players in the hospitality and travel ecosystem
Collaborate with internal teams (Sales, Marketing, Product, Legal) to structure and execute partnership agreements
Represent Rate Gain in industry events and partnership meetings to promote our brand and solutions
Monitor partner performance, engagement, and contribution to pipeline and revenue
Provide regular reporting and insights on partnership outcomes and market trends Education & Work Experience
Bachelor's degree in business, Marketing, or a related field
5+ years of experience in business development or strategic partnerships Knowledge:
In-depth understanding of the LATAM hospitality and travel technology ecosystem
Knowledge of Saa S business models and partnership structures
Awareness of regional trends, customer behavior, and competitive landscape in the travel and hospitality sectors Skills:
Strong negotiation and deal-closing capabilities
Excellent relationship management skills with ability to engage partners at all levels
Advanced verbal and written communication skills in Spanish, Portuguese, and English
Ability to identify, pitch, and convert strategic partnership opportunities
Proficiency in using CRM and sales enablement tools
Skilled in cross-functional collaboration with internal teams (Sales, Marketing, Legal, Product, etc.) Attitude:
Proactive and results-oriented, with a strong drive to exceed targets
Entrepreneurial mindset with a passion for growth and innovation
Culturally sensitive and collaborative, with the ability to work effectively in a global, remote team
High level of integrity, professionalism, and ownership
Resilient and adaptable in a fast-paced and evolving environment Equal Opportunity Employer
