title: Technical business analyst id52085
description:
Job Description Agile Engine is an Inc. 5000 company that creates award-winning software for Fortune 500 brands and trailblazing startups across 17+ industries. We rank among the leaders in areas like application development and AI/ML, and our people-first culture has earned us multiple Best Place to Work awards.
WHY JOIN US
If you're looking for a place to grow, make an impact, and work with people who care, we'd love to meet you!
ABOUT THE ROLE
As a Business Analyst in data and digital transformation, you will play a pivotal role in connecting business goals with technical solutions, shaping how teams leverage data and integrations across the organization. You’ll influence the design of processes, pipelines, and analytics, driving efficiency and insight while collaborating with cross-functional teams in an Agile environment. This is a unique opportunity to work at the intersection of business strategy and technology, contributing directly to measurable impact and professional growth in a dynamic, collaborative culture.
WHAT YOU WILL DO
- Partner with stakeholders across departments to capture and validate business needs
- Translate business concepts into structured technical requirements, use cases, and user stories
- Define data and integration requirements in collaboration with architects
- Map current- and future-state processes, identifying opportunities for automation and efficiency
- Maintain a clear traceability matrix linking business requests to delivered functionality
- Work with Data Engineering and Analytics teams to clarify metric definitions, data transformations, and aggregation rules
- Support efforts to standardize KPIs and enable self-service analytics using BI tools
- Validate data outputs and ensure alignment with business definitions and governance standards
- Collaborate with data governance leadership to ensure quality, compliance, and consistent usage of data assets
- Assist in the design and implementation of new data pipelines, APIs, and system integrations across cloud environments
- Partner with architects to document data lineage, source-to-target mappings, and system dependencies
- Analyze and communicate technical constraints, data availability, and system impacts to business sponsors
- Coordinate with engineering teams to perform user acceptance testing and validate results
MUST HAVES
- 5+ years of experience as a Business Analyst, Technical Analyst, or Product Owner in data, IT, or digital transformation contexts
- Strong ability to bridge business language and technical concepts

title: Senior analytics engineer
description:
Company Description
United Hub Digital (UHD) is a nearshore IT consulting firm helping mid and large US enterprise clients accelerate their data and technology initiatives. Headquartered in Greenville, SC, with a delivery hub in Brazil, we embed directly into client teams as a trusted execution partner across data analytics, software development, UI/UX, and project management. We hold ourselves to the same standards of accountability and delivery quality our clients expect from their own teams.
About the Role
We are looking for a Senior Analytics Engineer to help one of our enterprise clients unlock the value of their data for AI-driven use cases. The goal focus for this role is to 'make the data AI-ready': well-structured, semantically rich, documented, and governed.
Your primary output is a clean, well-documented, and semantically meaningful data environment that downstream AI workloads can reason over reliably.
------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
What You Will Do
Semantic Modeling
Design and build semantic layers that translate raw ERP tables into business-meaningful domains (finance, procurement, supply chain, etc.)
Define and enforce naming conventions, metric definitions, and business logic in a shared, governed layer
Work with Databricks semantic layer to expose curated datasets for AI and analytics consumption Data Documentation and Context
Produce column-level documentation, data dictionaries, and business glossaries inside Unity Catalog
Establish lineage tracing from source system tables through to consumption-ready datasets
Collaborate with source systems stakeholders to capture domain knowledge and translate it into structured metadata AI Readiness
Structure data to support LLM-based and ML workloads, including RAG pipelines and structured querying
Identify and address data quality gaps that would undermine AI model reliability
Define thematic data domains and organize datasets to give AI systems the right context and scope Governance and Quality
Implement data quality rules and freshness monitors using Databricks tooling
Tag sensitive fields and support data access tier definitions within Unity Catalog
Own documentation standards and ensure the catalog remains accurate as data evolves ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Qualifications
Required
5+ years in analytics engineering, data architecture, or a closely related discipline
Hands-on Databricks expertise: Unity Catalog, Delta Lake, cluster configuration, and query optimization
Experience with semantic modeling tools, ideally dbt (dbt Core or dbt Cloud)
Strong SQL and a solid understanding of data modeling patterns (star schema, medallion architecture, etc.)
Ability to read and interpret unfamiliar data models quickly, including ERP-sourced data structures
Experience writing technical documentation that non-technical stakeholders can act on Nice to Have
Exposure to Databricks AI/BI, Genie, or Vector Search
Experience supporting ML or LLM-based downstream use cases
Background in data mesh or domain-oriented data architecture

title: Salesforce developer
description:
Company Description
We are a software startup dedicated to unifying ERP and CRM solutions into one seamless platform. As we prepare for growth, we are seeking an experienced Salesforce Developer that has hands-on experience, particularly with integrations and solution design and implementation.
Role Description
This is a full-time remote position for a Salesforce Developer. The Salesforce Developer will be responsible for designing, developing, and customizing Salesforce solutions, including creating and optimizing Visualforce Pages and Lightning Web Components. Responsibilities also include Salesforce.com administration, integration with other enterprise applications, troubleshooting, and maintaining scalable and secure solutions. Collaboration with cross-functional teams to meet business requirements is integral to this role. While remote, this role will be working during Eastern Standard Timezone (US) hours from 8am to 5pm.
Key Responsibilities
Develop and customize Salesforce applications using Lightning and Apex
Collaborate with functional teams to gather and analyze business requirements
Build scalable, secure, and high-performance solutions
Perform debugging, testing, and deployment activities
Provide ongoing support and enhancements to existing applications Qualifications
In-depth understanding of Salesforce.com platform capabilities and customization
2–5 years of hands-on experience in Salesforce development
Bachelor's degree in computer science, Information Systems or related field
Strong expertise in Salesforce Lightning (LWC/Aura)
Experience with Agentic AI or AI-based solutions is a plus
Solid understanding of Apex, Triggers, Workflows, SOQL/SOSL, and integrations
Excellent troubleshooting and problem-solving skills
Experience with Salesforce.com Administration tasks and configuration
Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to work with cross-functional teams
Salesforce Developer Certification or equivalent is preferred
Excellent communication skills and the ability to work effectively in a remote, global environment
Customize UI/UX within Salesforce Company Perks & Benefits
Observance of major US Federal Holidays
10 Paid Vacation Days + 5 Personal Days + 5 Sick Days in the 1st year of employment
Annual performance bonus
Client and employee referral bonus program

description:

title: Engenheiro de dados sênior
description:
Sobre a Volpi
Somos uma fintech em crescimento acelerado que está protagonizando a evolução do financiamento imobiliário. Transformamos processos tradicionalmente burocráticos, caros e ineficientes em experiências inteligentes, simples e digitais. Se você acredita que tecnologia pode mudar a vida das pessoas - e quer fazer parte de uma equipe que vive isso na prática - vem com a gente!
O desafio
Buscamos um Senior Data Engineer para liderar a construção da engenharia de dados da Volpi desde a base.
Hoje, nossos dados estão distribuídos em múltiplas fontes, com diferentes níveis de maturidade. Seu papel será estruturar essa fundação: definir a arquitetura, organizar os dados, criar pipelines confiáveis e habilitar a criação de produtos de dados que apoiem decisões críticas de negócio.
Aqui, você terá alto nível de autonomia e ownership, tomando decisões técnicas que vão sustentar o crescimento da empresa nos próximos anos.
O que você vai fazer:
Desenhar, implementar e evoluir a arquitetura de dados da Volpi, com foco em um modelo de lakehouse na AWS;
Estruturar pipelines de ingestão, transformação e consumo de dados (batch e, futuramente, streaming);
Trabalhar com dados sensíveis de crédito e pessoas, seguindo padrões rigorosos de segurança, governança e compliance;
Lidar com dados distribuídos em múltiplos silos, conectando fontes e criando visões mais maduras para o negócio;
Atender demandas estratégicas de diferentes áreas (crédito, operações, produto, engenharia);
Organizar e evoluir o data lake existente (já temos estrutura inicial em AWS, Athena e S3);
Criar a base para produtos de dados futuros, incluindo análises avançadas de crédito e soluções orientadas a dados;
Atuar de forma full-cycle, da concepção técnica à implementação, operação e evolução em produção. O que esperamos de você:
Experiência sólida como Data Engineer, com forte mentalidade de engenharia (Data Engineer aqui é dev);
Domínio de Python e SQL para construção de pipelines e soluções de dados em produção;
Experiência prática com AWS, especialmente serviços como S3, Athena e IAM;
Conhecimento e uso de Infraestrutura como Código (Ia C);
Vivência com pipelines de dados em produção, lidando com volumes relevantes e dados sensíveis;
Forte preocupação com segurança da informação, padrões de projeto e boas práticas de engenharia;
Experiência em ambientes de startup, lidando com pouco legado e muita construção do zero;
Autonomia para tomar decisões técnicas e conduzir projetos end-to-end;
Capacidade de traduzir necessidades de negócio em soluções de dados escaláveis;
Comunicação clara e estruturada, especialmente em ambientes assíncronos. Será considerado um diferencial:
Experiência com arquiteturas de dados modernas, como lakehouse;
Uso de ferramentas de orquestração e transformação de dados (ex: Airflow, dbt ou similares);
Atuação em domínios complexos e regulados, como financeiro, crédito ou seguros;
Vivência na construção e estruturação de plataformas ou áreas de dados desde o início. Benefícios que oferecemos:

About The Methodical Group
The Methodical Group (methodicalgroup.com) is a leading global provider of IT Services, Consulting, and Specialized Staffing Solutions, operating with a systematic, high-quality approach for over 25 years. Headquartered in St. Petersburg, Florida, we use proprietary frameworks, such as Exact Talent, to provide specialized workforce solutions, including permanent placement and contract staffing, across industries such as IT and Healthcare. Simultaneously, our IT and Business Services division offers expert solutions in Software Development, Data & Analytics, and IT Operations, aiming to help organizations worldwide drive digital transformation, improve efficiency, and maintain a competitive edge.
About the Opportunity
Our client is seeking an Implementation Analyst to support their Professional Services team, leading end-to-end deployments of a Saa S platform across municipal government clients. This role combines project leadership, client engagement, and product expertise—guiding customers through configuration, setup, data migration, and training to ensure successful system adoption.

Excellent problem-solving, analytical, communication, organizational, and time-management skills.

title: Emerging market trader
description:
Role Overview
We are seeking a highly skilled Emerging Markets FX Trader with deep expertise in African and/or Latin American currencies to join our global trading & liquidity team. The ideal candidate will have extensive experience managing illiquid and restricted FX markets, executing OTC and interbank trades, and designing robust hedging and liquidity frameworks to support high-volume cross-border payment flows. This role requires both strong trading capability and infrastructure expertise, including building and optimizing FX trading systems, hedging engines, and liquidity connectivity with banks, brokers, and OTC counterparties.
Key Responsibilities
FX Trading & Liquidity Management
Manage proprietary and flow-driven FX trading positions across Emerging Market currencies, with a focus on African (e.g., NGN, KES, ZAR, GHS) or LATAM (e.g., BRL, MXN, COP, ARS) markets.
Source and maintain deep liquidity relationships with banks, brokers, and OTC desks across relevant regions.
Execute spot, forwards, NDFs, swaps, and OTC trades to optimize execution quality and manage currency exposure.
Monitor market developments, capital controls, and liquidity dynamics across EM FX markets. Hedging Strategy & Risk Management
Design and implement FX hedging strategies to manage corporate or client-driven exposures.
Optimize hedging efficiency across multiple liquidity venues including banks, ECNs, OTC desks, and crypto liquidity pools where relevant.
Develop models for dynamic hedging, inventory risk management, and spread optimization.
Monitor risk limits, Pn L, and exposure across currency books. Trading Infrastructure & Systems
Work closely with engineering and product teams to build and enhance FX trading and hedging infrastructure, including:
Automated hedging engines
Liquidity aggregation systems
Smart order routing
Pricing and risk management tools
Integrate connectivity with banks, ECNs, and liquidity providers via APIs or FIX protocols.
Improve execution automation, latency optimization, and real-time exposure monitoring. Market Development
Identify and onboard new liquidity providers and OTC trading partners across emerging markets.
Build pricing frameworks for illiquid currency pairs and support new corridor launches.
Contribute to the development of scalable FX infrastructure supporting global payments and settlement flows. Requirements
Experience
5–10+ years of FX trading experience in Emerging Markets.
Strong experience trading African or LATAM currencies, such as:
Africa: NGN, KES, ZAR, GHS, EGP
LATAM: BRL, MXN, COP, CLP, ARS
Experience working at:
Global banks
EM FX trading firms
Payment / fintech companies
Crypto exchanges or market makers
Proven experience executing OTC and institutional-sized FX trades. Technical Expertise
Deep understanding of:
FX market microstructure in illiquid markets
NDF markets and offshore hedging
Capital controls and FX regulatory frameworks
Hands-on experience building or optimizing:
FX trading systems
Hedging engines
Liquidity aggregation platforms
Familiarity with FIX connectivity, API-based trading systems, and algorithmic execution. Skills
Strong quantitative and analytical capabilities.
Ability to operate in high-volatility and fragmented liquidity environments.
Strong network within EM FX liquidity providers and OTC trading desks.
Excellent communication and cross-functional collaboration skills. Preferred Qualifications
Experience supporting high-volume cross-border payment flows or treasury operations.
Experience trading EM FX through both traditional banks and alternative liquidity sources.
Familiarity with stablecoin / crypto liquidity markets in emerging economies.
Background in building or scaling FX market-making operations.
Strong analytical and problem solving skills
Ability to operate across global teams and fast paced environments Vision & Mission
OSL is the first SFC-licensed digital asset platform in Hong Kong and a Pay Fi innovator. Through stablecoin payments, cross-border settlement and global licensing, we are building the next-generation payments network. Stablecoins have become everyday money across emerging markets and are widely viewed as blockchain's "killer app," with industry focus shifting from token issuance to real-world consumer and enterprise payment adoption. The strongest growth lies in cross-border B2 B payments, where providers embedding stablecoins into corporate settlement flows can capture significant volume and float. Long-term defensibility comes from regulatory licences, banking partners and cross-border corridors.
OSL holds or has acquired licences in Hong Kong, Japan, Australia, Bermuda and Indonesia, and is expanding into Europe, Brazil, Southeast Asia and Africa through acquisitions and licence applications. With OSL Pay and Stable X, we embed stablecoin settlement into bank accounts and card networks, support 150+ digital assets, and provide 24/7 fiat–stablecoin conversion. As a regulated pioneer with a startup mindset, we believe the future of payments will be driven by real adoption and scalable deployment, not technology narratives. We welcome builders who are passionate about crypto and payments to join us in shaping compliant, global payment infrastructure.

title: Strategic partnership & alliance
description:
About Rate Gain
Rate Gain Travel Technologies Limited is a global provider of AI-powered Saa S solutions for travel and hospitality that works with 3,200+ customers and 700+ partners in 100+ countries helping them accelerate revenue generation through acquisition, retention, and wallet share expansion. Rate Gain today is one of the world's largest processors of electronic transactions, price points, and travel intent data helping revenue management, distribution and marketing teams across hotels, airlines, meta-search companies, package providers, car rentals, travel management companies, cruises and ferries drive better outcomes for their business.
Founded in 2004 and headquartered in India, today Rate Gain works with 26 of the Top 30 Hotel Chains, 25 of the Top 30 Online Travel Agents, 4 of the Top 5 Airlines, and all the top car rentals, including 16 Global Fortune 500 companies in unlocking new revenue every day.
Exploring the role
Rate Gain is privileged to partner with hotels of every size and type around the world to achieve their commercial objectives – from independent, luxury, lifestyle, and boutique hotels, to the world's largest chains. Chains - and multi-site operators - have unique business requirements, additional complexity, and often use more diverse technology solutions. As a partner of choice for global and regional chains, Rate Gain is looking to further serve this important segment of the hospitality industry and seeks an experienced Director focused on European markets, to further scale this essential unit of our business.
The ideal candidate will understand how Latam hotel chains function and operate, and will be familiar with the technology solutions adopted by these chains to achieve their commercial objectives. title: Emerging market trader
description:
Role Overview
We are seeking a highly skilled Emerging Markets FX Trader with deep expertise in African and/or Latin American currencies to join our global trading & liquidity team. The ideal candidate will have extensive experience managing illiquid and restricted FX markets, executing OTC and interbank trades, and designing robust hedging and liquidity frameworks to support high-volume cross-border payment flows. This role requires both strong trading capability and infrastructure expertise, including building and optimizing FX trading systems, hedging engines, and liquidity connectivity with banks, brokers, and OTC counterparties.
Key Responsibilities
FX Trading & Liquidity Management
Manage proprietary and flow-driven FX trading positions across Emerging Market currencies, with a focus on African (e.g., NGN, KES, ZAR, GHS) or LATAM (e.g., BRL, MXN, COP, ARS) markets.
Source and maintain deep liquidity relationships with banks, brokers, and OTC desks across relevant regions.
Execute spot, forwards, NDFs, swaps, and OTC trades to optimize execution quality and manage currency exposure.
Monitor market developments, capital controls, and liquidity dynamics across EM FX markets. Hedging Strategy & Risk Management
Design and implement FX hedging strategies to manage corporate or client-driven exposures.
Optimize hedging efficiency across multiple liquidity venues including banks, ECNs, OTC desks, and crypto liquidity pools where relevant.
Develop models for dynamic hedging, inventory risk management, and spread optimization.
Monitor risk limits, Pn L, and exposure across currency books. Trading Infrastructure & Systems
Work closely with engineering and product teams to build and enhance FX trading and hedging infrastructure, including:
Automated hedging engines
Liquidity aggregation systems
Smart order routing
Pricing and risk management tools
Integrate connectivity with banks, ECNs, and liquidity providers via APIs or FIX protocols.
Improve execution automation, latency optimization, and real-time exposure monitoring. Market Development
Identify and onboard new liquidity providers and OTC trading partners across emerging markets.
Build pricing frameworks for illiquid currency pairs and support new corridor launches.
Contribute to the development of scalable FX infrastructure supporting global payments and settlement flows. Requirements
Experience
5–10+ years of FX trading experience in Emerging Markets.
Strong experience trading African or LATAM currencies, such as:
Africa: NGN, KES, ZAR, GHS, EGP
LATAM: BRL, MXN, COP, CLP, ARS
Experience working at:
Global banks
EM FX trading firms
Payment / fintech companies
Crypto exchanges or market makers
Proven experience executing OTC and institutional-sized FX trades. Technical Expertise
Deep understanding of:
FX market microstructure in illiquid markets
NDF markets and offshore hedging
Capital controls and FX regulatory frameworks
Hands-on experience building or optimizing:
FX trading systems
Hedging engines
Liquidity aggregation platforms
Familiarity with FIX connectivity, API-based trading systems, and algorithmic execution. Skills
Strong quantitative and analytical capabilities.
Ability to operate in high-volatility and fragmented liquidity environments.
Strong network within EM FX liquidity providers and OTC trading desks.
Excellent communication and cross-functional collaboration skills. Preferred Qualifications
Experience supporting high-volume cross-border payment flows or treasury operations.
Experience trading EM FX through both traditional banks and alternative liquidity sources.
Familiarity with stablecoin / crypto liquidity markets in emerging economies.
Background in building or scaling FX market-making operations.
Strong analytical and problem solving skills
Ability to operate across global teams and fast paced environments Vision & Mission
OSL is the first SFC-licensed digital asset platform in Hong Kong and a Pay Fi innovator. Through stablecoin payments, cross-border settlement and global licensing, we are building the next-generation payments network. Stablecoins have become everyday money across emerging markets and are widely viewed as blockchain's "killer app," with industry focus shifting from token issuance to real-world consumer and enterprise payment adoption. The strongest growth lies in cross-border B2 B payments, where providers embedding stablecoins into corporate settlement flows can capture significant volume and float. Long-term defensibility comes from regulatory licences, banking partners and cross-border corridors.
OSL holds or has acquired licences in Hong Kong, Japan, Australia, Bermuda and Indonesia, and is expanding into Europe, Brazil, Southeast Asia and Africa through acquisitions and licence applications. With OSL Pay and Stable X, we embed stablecoin settlement into bank accounts and card networks, support 150+ digital assets, and provide 24/7 fiat–stablecoin conversion. As a regulated pioneer with a startup mindset, we believe the future of payments will be driven by real adoption and scalable deployment, not technology narratives. We welcome builders who are passionate about crypto and payments to join us in shaping compliant, global payment infrastructure.

Mais de 5 anos de experiência em administração Service Now nas seguintes áreas: Service Catalog, CMDB & Discovery, Service Portal, Workflows, Dashboards, REST APIs
Experiência prévia com o módulo APM é desejável
Outras habilidades e competências

Apoiar iniciativas de BMP fornecendo insights sobre performance do negócio, eficiência operacional, direcionadores financeiros e KPIs estratégicos.
Projetar, desenvolver e manter dashboards, relatórios e modelos analíticos para acompanhar a performance em relação às metas e apoiar a tomada de decisão da liderança.
Conduzir análises ad hoc e aprofundadas para explicar tendências, variações, riscos e oportunidades, além de avaliar o impacto de iniciativas de negócio.
Trabalhar em estreita colaboração com stakeholders para entender objetivos, definir métricas relevantes e garantir que as entregas analíticas estejam alinhadas às necessidades de decisão.

Sintetizar análises complexas em narrativas claras e objetivas, apresentando resultados que traduzam dados em insights acionáveis para a liderança sênior.

Mestrado em Analytics, Ciência de Dados, Economia, Estatística, Engenharia, Administração ou área quantitativa relacionada.

Experiência sólida com SQL e pelo menos uma linguagem de programação analítica (Python ou equivalente).

title: Accounting manager
description:
TGG Way Accounting Manager
Location: Fully Remote working for US-Based Clients
About Us
We are a dynamic and growing accounting firm specializing in providing financial services across a wide range of industries. Our team is composed of highly skilled professionals who are passionate about delivering exceptional results and building long-term client relationships. TGG Accounting is growing, and we're looking for an Accounting Manager to join our remote team.
The Accounting Manager owns all accounting outcomes for assigned clients, ensuring accuracy, completeness, and adherence to TGG Way standards. They oversee Staff Accountant transactional work, uphold controls and processes, and guide team execution to deliver reliable financial statements to the Controller.
Responsibilities
Weekly
• Review customer invoicing
• Review vendor bills and submit payments
• Approve and submit payroll
• Perform P& L scrubs
• Review cash flow forecasts
• Resolve collections issues
• Manage weekly recurring accounting processes as directed by the Controller
Monthly
• Complete the full client Technical QA checklist through the Month-End Workbook
• Ensure accuracy of the balance sheet workbook
• Perform source document filing spot checks
• Calculate monthly sales tax prepayments and submit to Controller for review and
payment
• Review the final P& L scrub and approve journal entries prepared by the Staff
Accountant
• Review and finalize financial notes in financial packages
• Review financial statements and supporting schedules prepared by the Staff
Accountant
• Understand the purpose of existing KPIs and roll them forward each month

graphs, and footnotes
• Provide feedback to Staff Accountants about technical updates to improve their
technical accounting skills
• Review process and procedural documents

• Review the chart of accounts

statement to retained earnings

Workbook, and Financial Package

Paid training in U. S. GAAP and internal processes
Access to TGG University and learning resources
Career development / Long-term growth opportunities within a global firm

This position is to join us as Independent Contractor

Working Equipment to start is required

About TGG Accounting
At TGG Accounting, our mission is to make business owners' lives better through excellent financial management. We provide outsourced accounting and advisory services to small and mid-size businesses, helping them build strong financial foundations, plan for growth, and make better decisions.
We are more than 250 teammates, located across the U. S. and around the world, in the Philippines, Argentina, Ecuador, Chile, Brazil, Peru, and Mexico, working together in a vibrant, multicultural environment to deliver on our mission.

Loyalty

title: Strategic partnership & alliance
description:
About Rate Gain
Rate Gain Travel Technologies Limited is a global provider of AI-powered Saa S solutions for travel and hospitality that works with 3,200+ customers and 700+ partners in 100+ countries helping them accelerate revenue generation through acquisition, retention, and wallet share expansion. Rate Gain today is one of the world's largest processors of electronic transactions, price points, and travel intent data helping revenue management, distribution and marketing teams across hotels, airlines, meta-search companies, package providers, car rentals, travel management companies, cruises and ferries drive better outcomes for their business.
Founded in 2004 and headquartered in India, today Rate Gain works with 26 of the Top 30 Hotel Chains, 25 of the Top 30 Online Travel Agents, 4 of the Top 5 Airlines, and all the top car rentals, including 16 Global Fortune 500 companies in unlocking new revenue every day.
Exploring the role
Rate Gain is privileged to partner with hotels of every size and type around the world to achieve their commercial objectives – from independent, luxury, lifestyle, and boutique hotels, to the world's largest chains. Chains - and multi-site operators - have unique business requirements, additional complexity, and often use more diverse technology solutions. As a partner of choice for global and regional chains, Rate Gain is looking to further serve this important segment of the hospitality industry and seeks an experienced Director focused on European markets, to further scale this essential unit of our business.
The ideal candidate will understand how Latam hotel chains function and operate, and will be familiar with the technology solutions adopted by these chains to achieve their commercial objectives. The role requires a trusted advisor, able to assist chains to manage through the complexities of the travel technology eco system to guide them to the right decisions in the areas of distribution, business intelligence, marketing technologies, and beyond.
This is an individual contributor role and, as such, the candidate is expected to be a self-started and self-driven, ready to innovate to find new values for our hotel chain clients whilst keeping the company goals and the bigger picture firmly in mind. This position can be based anywhere in Latam and needs to have the ability to travel within the Latam without limitations.
How your day will look like/Job responsibility
Build and manage strategic alliances with regional and local partners (e.g. RMS, PMS, booking engines, OTAs)
Define and execute a partnership roadmap aligned with Rate Gain's GTM strategy in LATAM
Identify co-marketing, co-selling, and integration opportunities with key players in the hospitality and travel ecosystem
Collaborate with internal teams (Sales, Marketing, Product, Legal) to structure and execute partnership agreements
Represent Rate Gain in industry events and partnership meetings to promote our brand and solutions
Monitor partner performance, engagement, and contribution to pipeline and revenue
Provide regular reporting and insights on partnership outcomes and market trends Education & Work Experience
Bachelor's degree in business, Marketing, or a related field
5+ years of experience in business development or strategic partnerships Knowledge:
In-depth understanding of the LATAM hospitality and travel technology ecosystem
Knowledge of Saa S business models and partnership structures
Awareness of regional trends, customer behavior, and competitive landscape in the travel and hospitality sectors Skills:
Strong negotiation and deal-closing capabilities
Excellent relationship management skills with ability to engage partners at all levels
Advanced verbal and written communication skills in Spanish, Portuguese, and English
Ability to identify, pitch, and convert strategic partnership opportunities
Proficiency in using CRM and sales enablement tools
Skilled in cross-functional collaboration with internal teams (Sales, Marketing, Legal, Product, etc.) Attitude:
Proactive and results-oriented, with a strong drive to exceed targets
Entrepreneurial mindset with a passion for growth and innovation
Culturally sensitive and collaborative, with the ability to work effectively in a global, remote team
High level of integrity, professionalism, and ownership
Resilient and adaptable in a fast-paced and evolving environment Equal Opportunity Employer
We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer and are committed to providing a diverse and inclusive workplace. We welcome and encourage applications from all qualified individuals, regardless of race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, genetic information, disability, or veteran status.

O Engenheiro de Soluções deve apoiar o crescimento de vendas da Good We desenvolvendo fortes relacionamentos com os stakeholders técnicos da rede de distribuidores, instaladores e EPCs da Good We no Brasil, garantindo a confiança deles nas soluções e produtos da Good We. Conduzir treinamentos presenciais e online para os clientes, criar e gerenciar documentação técnica local, estabelecer uma base de conhecimento e representar a Good We em exposições. Fornecer informações ou feedbacks em tempo hábil para propostas de clientes, fornecendo os detalhes técnicos das soluções propostas.
Responsabilidades
Realizar workshops e treinamentos presenciais para parceiros e clientes;
Realizar webinars e treinamentos online para parceiros e clientes;
Apoiar as equipes de vendas na especificação de projetos;
Apoiar as equipes de vendas em visitas a clientes em negociações estratégicas;
Realizar simulações de projetos e design para clientes;
Realizar tradução de documentos técnicos (fichas técnicas, manuais de usuário, brochuras, apresentações de revistas, etc.);
Criar e desenvolver apresentações de portfólio;
Criar e desenvolver apresentações de produtos e funcionalidades;
Criar documentos de SOP sobre produtos e funcionalidades;
Criar vídeos de SOP sobre produtos e funcionalidades;
Gerenciar e participar de exposições e feiras de energia solar (FV);
Realizar palestras e apresentações presenciais em fóruns e eventos de energia solar (FV);
Fornecer treinamento para a equipe interna brasileira (engenheiros de pós-vendas, equipes de marketing, equipes de vendas, etc.);
Configurar e gerenciar a comunidade online da Good We Solar Academy no Brasil;
Configurar e gerenciar as redes sociais da Good We Solar Academy no Brasil;
Prestar suporte ao cliente em questões de Pré-Vendas;
Treinar e certificar a equipe técnica dos parceiros de acordo com a política de canais;
Trabalhar em estreita colaboração com as equipes da matriz para entender e transmitir as especificações corretas do nosso portfólio para a equipe local, parceiros e clientes;
Trabalhar ativamente com a equipe de marketing para estabelecer uma rede de promoção com parceiros de terceiros (empresas de treinamento, influenciadores digitais e distribuidores);
Apoiar a equipe de marketing na criação de conteúdo e promoções;
Configurar e estabelecer um centro de treinamento no Brasil;
Apoiar os gerentes de Produtos e Pré-Vendas na definição do portfólio local;
Coletar demandas de produtos do mercado brasileiro;
Analisar as demandas de mercado e propor novos produtos e funcionalidades;
Coletar e organizar informações sobre produtos, soluções e principais informações de clientes concorrentes;
Analisar e fornecer feedback sobre requisitos de normas regulatórias locais. Habilidades Requeridas
Proficiência em mandarim
Graduação em Engenharia Elétrica, Fotovoltaica, Energias Renováveis ou formação similar;
Conhecimento avançado de inversores fotovoltaicos;
Pelo menos 2 anos de experiência com inversores fotovoltaicos;
Pelo menos 3 anos de experiência no mercado fotovoltaico brasileiro;
Experiência com GD, experiência com projetos de GC é um diferencial;
Experiência com inversores de armazenamento de energia fotovoltaica;
Experiência com baterias de chumbo-ácido e lítio para sistemas de armazenamento fotovoltaico;
Conhecimento geral de eletricidade, produtos, soluções de produtos e processos;
Excelentes conhecimentos em Auto CAD e PVSyst;
Fortes habilidades analíticas, atenção aos detalhes e habilidades de comunicação;
Domínio do MS Office e outros softwares de energia solar (PV);
Conhecimento avançado em MS Power Point;
Ampla rede de contatos no setor de energia renovável, principalmente na indústria solar fotovoltaica;
Fortes habilidades de ensino e comunicação. Atributos
Proatividade;
Excelentes habilidades organizacionais com capacidade de rapidamente avaliar prioridades;
Mentalidade internacional para um ambiente multicultural;
Fortes relações no mercado fotovoltaico brasileiro;
Trabalho em equipe;
Independência (trabalhar sem supervisão direta);
Senso de urgência;
Multitarefa;
Disponibilidade para viagens de negócios;
Disponibilidade para se mudar de cidade.

title: Executivo de vendas
description:
Estamos em busca de um(a) profissional com perfil técnico-comercial para atuar como Executivo de Vendas em um segmento industrial altamente especializado, focado em soluções de detecção e separação de metais em processos produtivos.
Se você gosta de desafios, tem perfil consultivo e quer atuar diretamente no campo, contribuindo com soluções técnicas que geram impacto real nos clientes, essa oportunidade é para você.
Sobre a posição
Você será responsável por conduzir todo o processo comercial, desde a prospecção até o fechamento, com forte atuação em campo. Além disso, terá papel fundamental na demonstração prática de equipamentos, suporte técnico e desenvolvimento de soluções personalizadas para clientes industriais.
Principais responsabilidades:
Realizar prospecção ativa e visitas a clientes em diferentes regiões;
Conduzir apresentações técnicas e demonstrações de equipamentos em campo;
Levantar necessidades e desenvolver propostas comerciais alinhadas ao cliente;
Gerenciar o ciclo completo de vendas (prospecção, negociação e fechamento);
Expandir e desenvolver a carteira de clientes;
Acompanhar tendências de mercado e atuação da concorrência;
Elaborar relatórios comerciais e acompanhar indicadores de desempenho;
Atuar de forma integrada com áreas internas e parceiros comerciais;
Apoiar testes, treinamentos e implementação de soluções junto aos clientes. O que buscamos:
Formação superior em Engenharia (Controle e Automação, Elétrica, Mecânica, Produção) ou cursos técnicos correlatos (Mecatrônica, Elétrica, Automação);
Experiência em vendas externas no segmento industrial;
Vivência com automação, instrumentação ou processos produtivos será um diferencial;
Conhecimento em ambientes industriais e linhas produtivas;
Inglês intermediário ou avançado;
Disponibilidade para viagens frequentes. Perfil desejado:
Proatividade e autonomia;
Forte orientação para resultados;
Perfil consultivo e boa comunicação;
Organização e disciplina na gestão de atividades comerciais;
Capacidade analítica para entender problemas e propor soluções;
Postura colaborativa e senso de responsabilidade. Modelo de trabalho
Atuação majoritariamente em campo, com base em home office e disponibilidade para viagens.

title: Business development manager
description:
About Us:
Temu is seeking a highly motivated and experienced Business Development Managerto join our team. As a rapidly growing company, we are looking for talented individuals committed to helping us achieve our goals. In this role, you will have the opportunity to work with a team of driven individuals dedicated to making a difference in the industry.
Responsibilities
Proactively recruit and develop effective local partnerships with merchandise partners, manufacturers, and brands. Focus on categories selections to increase overall value, in alignment with business and customer needs.
Assist merchandise partners in establishing themselves on the platform and their growth. Guide merchandise partners in developing comprehensive plans including market positioning, product planning, brand marketing, and operational strategies.
Propose innovative ideas based on the current status of the categories, as well as create and implement projects through resource integration and merchant guidance.
Conduct industry analysis reports, explore potential customer needs through data analysis, and adjust strategies accordingly based on market trends. Required skills / Minimum Qualifications
5+ years of operational experience, including but not limited to experience in brand management or platform operations.
Extensive connections and relationships with local seller and vendor networks is a plus.
Strong data analysis skills, able to analyze industry trends and project management through data, and summarize conclusions.
Possesses market exploration and marketing innovation capabilities, capable of guiding overall merchant marketing plans.
Excellent problem-solving skills, self-motivation, ability to think strategically and adapt quickly to changes.
Ability to work under pressure and manage logistics during high-demand periods. Equal Employment Statement
At Temu, we are proud to be an employer that builds a diverse community. We encourage all qualified individuals to apply and join our team. We are dedicated to providing a work environment free from discrimination and harassment, where all employees are treated with respect and dignity.
Apply today to join Temu and be part of a dynamic and innovative company.

title: Desenvolvedor .net
description:
Vaga: Desenvolvedor. NET Core
⸻
Sobre o Wite Group / Wite Tec
O Wite Group, por meio da Wite Tec, é uma empresa orientada à construção de produtos digitais com impacto real no negócio. Atuamos com alto nível de responsabilidade técnica, foco em eficiência operacional e compromisso com entrega consistente em ambiente de produção. Não somos uma empresa de experimentação superficial — valorizamos profissionais que assumem ownership, tomam decisões e sustentam sistemas críticos com qualidade e previsibilidade.
⸻
Sobre a posição
Buscamos um desenvolvedor. NET Core com forte capacidade de execução, que saiba transformar demandas em soluções funcionais, escaláveis e seguras. O profissional será responsável por atuar diretamente no desenvolvimento e manutenção de sistemas em produção, com autonomia para propor melhorias e responsabilidade sobre o que entrega.
Não buscamos apenas alguém que "sabe programar", mas alguém que resolve problemas reais, entende impacto de negócio e entrega com consistência.
⸻
Responsabilidades
• Desenvolver, manter e evoluir aplicações utilizando. NET Core
• Trabalhar com APIs REST de forma estruturada e performática
• Garantir qualidade de código, legibilidade e manutenção a longo prazo
• Participar de decisões técnicas com foco em eficiência e escalabilidade
• Atuar na identificação e correção de problemas em ambiente produtivo
• Colaborar com outras áreas (produto, dados, operações) para entregar soluções completas
• Assumir responsabilidade direta por entregas, prazos e estabilidade do sistema
⸻
Requisitos técnicos (Hard Skills)
• Domínio prático de. NET Core e C#
• Experiência com desenvolvimento de APIs REST
• Conhecimento sólido em banco de dados (SQL Server ou similar)
• Entendimento de arquitetura de sistemas (camadas, separação de responsabilidades)
• Experiência com versionamento de código (Git)
• Capacidade de debugar, identificar e resolver problemas reais em produção
• Noções de performance, segurança e boas práticas de desenvolvimento
⸻
Competências comportamentais (Soft Skills)
• Alto senso de responsabilidade (não terceiriza problema)
• Capacidade de execução sem depender de microgerenciamento
• Pensamento crítico e orientação à solução
• Organização e clareza na comunicação
• Maturidade para lidar com pressão e priorização
• Proatividade para identificar melhorias e agir
⸻
Observação final
Buscamos um profissional com alto nível de execução, que entrega, sustenta e evolui sistemas com responsabilidade real. Aqui, resultado prático é mais importante do que discurso técnico.

title: Desenvolvedor servicenow | especialista técnico de aplicações
description:
Descrição da Vaga (JD):
O desenvolvedor Service Now fará parte de uma equipe já estabelecida, apoiando a implementação do módulo Application Portfolio Management (APM) do Service Now. O profissional será responsável por ativar e configurar o módulo, além de trabalhar em estreita colaboração com os times funcionais para definir o escopo e os objetivos do sistema.
Como Especialista Técnico de Aplicações, você poderá esperar:
Formular e definir o escopo e os objetivos do sistema.
Ser responsável pelo design do programa, codificação, testes, depuração e documentação.
Ter conhecimento técnico e responsabilidade por todas as fases de análise e programação de sistemas de aplicações.
Compreender o negócio ou a função para a qual a aplicação está sendo projetada.
Aprender continuamente sobre novas tecnologias, gerar novas ideias e melhorar o uso de tecnologias modernas em todo o portfólio de aplicações.
Configurar e ativar o Application Portfolio Management (APM).
Desenvolver relacionamentos de Itens de Configuração (CIs) para Capacidades de Negócio, Objetos de Informação, Aplicações de Negócio e Serviços de Aplicação.
Integrar o APM com outros módulos do Service Now, incluindo ITSM e SAM.
Utilizar fortes competências técnicas e expertise para identificar, analisar e solucionar problemas em produção, mantendo procedimentos que atendam às expectativas dos usuários de negócio.
Trabalhar em estreita colaboração com equipes multifuncionais e times de desenvolvimento para entender e fornecer soluções/correções automatizadas.
Contribuir para a melhoria contínua dos processos de Delivery e Suporte, bem como para a maturidade dos diferentes portfólios, capacidades, especializações e melhores práticas, considerando as necessidades e requisitos dos usuários e stakeholders.
Participar de eventos SCRUM e concluir os itens atribuídos dentro da meta definida para a Sprint.
Reunir-se com stakeholders-chave e acompanhar os itens de ação para quaisquer soluções alternativas necessárias, de acordo com a natureza dos requisitos.
Qualificações e Requisitos
Qualificações essenciais
• Graduação ou Mestrado em Computação, Eletrônica ou área relacionada
• Certificação Service Now System Administrator (CSA)
• Certificação Service Now Certified Application Portfolio Management (APM) Implementer
• Excelente comunicação verbal e escrita, com capacidade de comunicar informações técnicas para públicos não técnicos
Competências-chave
8 a 10 anos de experiência total na área de TI
Conhecimento intermediário em linguagens de desenvolvimento: XML, HTML, CSS, Java e Java Script
Experiência na plataforma Service Now como Administrador e Desenvolvedor
Experiência no desenvolvimento de Service Catalogs, implementação de ACLs, transform maps, Flows via Flow Designer, client scripts e métricas de saúde da CMDB
Configuração de Assessments, Demands, Business Capability Maps e Information Objects
Mais de 5 anos de experiência em administração Service Now nas seguintes áreas: Service Catalog, CMDB & Discovery, Service Portal, Workflows, Dashboards, REST APIs
Experiência prévia com o módulo APM é desejável
Outras habilidades e competências
Capacidade de adaptação rápida para aprender novas ferramentas, novas tecnologias e padrões atuais do mercado
Capacidade de trabalhar em ambiente global e distribuído, sem supervisão
Perfil autodirigido, proativo e com pensamento sistêmico

title: Engenheiro(a) de software full stack sênior
description:
Descrição:
Título da Posição: Engenheiro(a) de Software Full Stack Sênior
Tipo de contratação: Temporário via agência
Modelo de trabalho: Home office
Número de vagas: 2
Formação mínima exigida: Bacharelado em Ciência da Computação ou área relacionada, ou experiência equivalente.
Top 3 requisitos obrigatórios no currículo:
Forte experiência em desenvolvimento backend com atuação prática em serviços AWS.
Experiência comprovada no design e construção de sistemas distribuídos e escaláveis.
Experiência Full Stack com desenvolvimento moderno de front-end (Node JS e React). Visão geral do processo seletivo:
Entrevista de Design de Sistemas com o time de engenharia, com foco em arquitetura e design de sistemas.
Entrevista de Resolução de Problemas com o gerente contratante e um engenheiro, para avaliar capacidade de resolução de problemas, comunicação e alinhamento com a equipe. Descrição da Vaga
Visão Geral da Posição
A equipe Autodesk Info360 está em busca de um(a) Engenheiro(a) de Software Sênior experiente para integrar o time. Nesta função, você ajudará a projetar, construir e escalar soluções cloud-native que impulsionam fluxos de trabalho modernos de gestão de recursos hídricos.
Esta é uma posição de alto impacto, com foco em backend e arquitetura em nuvem, mantendo também forte responsabilidade sobre experiências voltadas ao usuário.
Responsabilidades:
Desenvolver soluções inovadoras para gestão de recursos hídricos em fluxos de trabalho orientados a produto.
Projetar e construir serviços backend escaláveis e cloud-native na AWS, utilizando arquitetura híbrida entre containers e serverless.
Desenvolver código de qualidade para produção, testável, legível e eficiente.
Arquitetar e implementar processos complexos de carga e transformação de dados em alto volume e alta frequência, utilizando métodos e ferramentas ETL de ponta.
Fornecer orientação técnica e suporte aos colegas por meio de revisões de design, code reviews e colaboração contínua.
Projetar e desenvolver funcionalidades voltadas ao usuário utilizando React e ferramentas modernas de desenvolvimento web.
Atuar como líder técnico(a) em iniciativas específicas de engenharia, contribuindo para decisões arquiteturais e de implementação. Qualificações:
10+ anos de experiência profissional em desenvolvimento de software, incluindo experiência relevante em arquitetura de sistemas.
Experiência comprovada no design e construção de sistemas distribuídos e escaláveis.
Fortes habilidades de comunicação, tanto escrita quanto verbal, para articular ideias complexas a diferentes stakeholders.
Excelente capacidade analítica, de resolução de problemas e pensamento crítico.
Profunda expertise em desenvolvimento cloud-native, com experiência prática em serviços AWS como Lambda, API Gateway e Dynamo DB.
Experiência com AWS Io T é um diferencial.
Experiência com Infraestrutura como Código (Ia C) — Terraform ou Cloud Formation — é um diferencial.
3+ anos de experiência com React e seu ecossistema.
Conhecimento em conceitos de Machine Learning é um diferencial.

title: Fx trader
description:
Role Overview
We are seeking a highly skilled Emerging Markets FX Trader with deep expertise in African and/or Latin American currencies to join our global trading & liquidity team. The ideal candidate will have extensive experience managing illiquid and restricted FX markets, executing OTC and interbank trades, and designing robust hedging and liquidity frameworks to support high-volume cross-border payment flows. This role requires both strong trading capability and infrastructure expertise, including building and optimizing FX trading systems, hedging engines, and liquidity connectivity with banks, brokers, and OTC counterparties.
Key Responsibilities
FX Trading & Liquidity Management
Manage proprietary and flow-driven FX trading positions across Emerging Market currencies, with a focus on African (e.g., NGN, KES, ZAR, GHS) or LATAM (e.g., BRL, MXN, COP, ARS) markets.
Source and maintain deep liquidity relationships with banks, brokers, and OTC desks across relevant regions.
Execute spot, forwards, NDFs, swaps, and OTC trades to optimize execution quality and manage currency exposure.
Monitor market developments, capital controls, and liquidity dynamics across EM FX markets. Hedging Strategy & Risk Management
Design and implement FX hedging strategies to manage corporate or client-driven exposures.
Optimize hedging efficiency across multiple liquidity venues including banks, ECNs, OTC desks, and crypto liquidity pools where relevant.
Develop models for dynamic hedging, inventory risk management, and spread optimization.
Monitor risk limits, Pn L, and exposure across currency books. Trading Infrastructure & Systems
Work closely with engineering and product teams to build and enhance FX trading and hedging infrastructure, including:
Automated hedging engines
Liquidity aggregation systems
Smart order routing
Pricing and risk management tools
Integrate connectivity with banks, ECNs, and liquidity providers via APIs or FIX protocols.
Improve execution automation, latency optimization, and real-time exposure monitoring. Market Development
Identify and onboard new liquidity providers and OTC trading partners across emerging markets.
Build pricing frameworks for illiquid currency pairs and support new corridor launches.
Contribute to the development of scalable FX infrastructure supporting global payments and settlement flows. Requirements
Experience
5–10+ years of FX trading experience in Emerging Markets.
Strong experience trading African or LATAM currencies, such as:
Africa: NGN, KES, ZAR, GHS, EGP
LATAM: BRL, MXN, COP, CLP, ARS
Experience working at:
Global banks
EM FX trading firms
Payment / fintech companies
Crypto exchanges or market makers
Proven experience executing OTC and institutional-sized FX trades. Technical Expertise
Deep understanding of:
FX market microstructure in illiquid markets
NDF markets and offshore hedging
Capital controls and FX regulatory frameworks
Hands-on experience building or optimizing:
FX trading systems
Hedging engines
Liquidity aggregation platforms
Familiarity with FIX connectivity, API-based trading systems, and algorithmic execution. Skills
Strong quantitative and analytical capabilities.
Ability to operate in high-volatility and fragmented liquidity environments.
Strong network within EM FX liquidity providers and OTC trading desks.
Excellent communication and cross-functional collaboration skills. Preferred Qualifications
Experience supporting high-volume cross-border payment flows or treasury operations.
Experience trading EM FX through both traditional banks and alternative liquidity sources.
Familiarity with stablecoin / crypto liquidity markets in emerging economies.
Background in building or scaling FX market-making operations.
Strong analytical and problem solving skills
Ability to operate across global teams and fast paced environments Vision & Mission
OSL is the first SFC-licensed digital asset platform in Hong Kong and a Pay Fi innovator. Through stablecoin payments, cross-border settlement and global licensing, we are building the next-generation payments network. Stablecoins have become everyday money across emerging markets and are widely viewed as blockchain's "killer app," with industry focus shifting from token issuance to real-world consumer and enterprise payment adoption. The strongest growth lies in cross-border B2 B payments, where providers embedding stablecoins into corporate settlement flows can capture significant volume and float. Long-term defensibility comes from regulatory licences, banking partners and cross-border corridors.
OSL holds or has acquired licences in Hong Kong, Japan, Australia, Bermuda and Indonesia, and is expanding into Europe, Brazil, Southeast Asia and Africa through acquisitions and licence applications. With OSL Pay and Stable X, we embed stablecoin settlement into bank accounts and card networks, support 150+ digital assets, and provide 24/7 fiat–stablecoin conversion. As a regulated pioneer with a startup mindset, we believe the future of payments will be driven by real adoption and scalable deployment, not technology narratives. We welcome builders who are passionate about crypto and payments to join us in shaping compliant, global payment infrastructure.

title: Web3 & al investment analyst
description:
Web3 DXB is a Dubai-based investment and research platform focused on identifying and scaling high-potential opportunities at the intersection of blockchain, artificial intelligence, and next-generation digital infrastructure. We combine deep market insight with an agile, thesis-driven approach to back transformative technologies shaping the future of finance and the internet.
As we expand our investment activities, we are looking for a highly analytical and forward-thinking Web3 & AI Investment Analyst to join our team. This is a fully remote position (Poland-based), offering direct exposure to early-stage deals, market research, and high-impact investment decisions across Web3 and AI.
This role is ideal for someone who lives at the edge of innovation — tracking narratives, identifying asymmetric opportunities, and translating complex trends into actionable investment insights. What You'll Be Doing
Conduct deep-dive research on Web3 and AI sectors, including protocols, startups, and emerging technologies.
Analyze market trends, narratives, and macro developments across crypto and AI ecosystems.
Evaluate investment opportunities, including token projects, early-stage startups, and infrastructure plays.
Build investment theses and present insights to internal stakeholders.
Monitor portfolio performance and track key metrics across projects.
Collaborate with internal teams on strategy, deal flow, and market positioning.
Stay ahead of industry developments, identifying early signals and high-potential opportunities. What We're Looking For
2–4+ years of experience in investment analysis, research, venture capital, or crypto/AI markets.
Strong understanding of blockchain, De Fi, tokenomics, and Web3 ecosystems.
Solid knowledge or strong interest in artificial intelligence and its investment landscape.
Exceptional analytical and research skills with the ability to synthesize complex information.
Experience evaluating startups, token models, or market opportunities.
Ability to think independently and form high-conviction investment views.
Fluent English with strong written communication skills.
High level of curiosity, ownership, and performance orientation. Why Join Web3 DXB

title: Talent manager - independent contractor
description:
Job description: Talent Manager(Independent Contractor)
**Must send resume in English**
Overview:
The Talent Manager is a critical, detail-driven role responsible for both managing relationships with our independent contractor virtual assistants and ensuring the accurate execution of ongoing administrative and operational tasks that support those relationships. This position plays a key role in Virtual Assistant retention by combining strong interpersonal skills with disciplined documentation, organization, and follow-through. Success in this role requires the ability to build trust, actively listen, and proactively resolve issues—while simultaneously maintaining precise records, managing time tracking, and supporting internal systems and processes that keep the business running smoothly.
Key Responsibilities:
Relationship Management
Conduct weekly check-in meetings with each assigned Virtual Assistant while accurately documenting discussions, action items, and follow-ups in real time.
Build and maintain professional, trust-based relationships with Virtual Assistants while encouraging open, honest dialogue.
Accurately document meeting notes, action items, and follow-ups in real time.
Keep Virtual Assistants accountable for meetings, calls, time submission, and other requests or requirements through clear tracking and follow-up.
Identify, document, and escalate potential issues or concerns to the leadership team with appropriate context and supporting notes.
Create a supportive and open communication environment with VAs, clients, and management.
Detect subtle communication cues and potential challenges, log observations, and alert management when appropriate. Administrative
Manage the full onboarding process for new Virtual Assistants, ensuring all documentation, checklists, and meetings are completed accurately and on time.
Manage the full onboarding process for new clients, ensuring all documentation, meetings, and follow-ups are completed accurately and on time.
Organize, maintain, and manage shared drives and digital files, ensuring proper document categorization, version control, and audit-ready internal documentation.
Perform basic website updates such as posting content or minor edits.
Reformat documents to ensure clarity, consistency, and professional presentation.
Compile reports, summaries, and data tracking related to VA performance, feedback, and engagement.
Maintain accurate and organized records of meetings, feedback, action items, and resolutions.
Oversee timesheet management, including tracking submissions, following up on missing or incorrect entries, and inputting approved hours into systems for payment processing Qualifications:
Bachelor's degree
Minimum 3 years of experience in HR, counseling, or relationship management
Proven ability to build quick trust and extract meaningful information
Exceptional English verbal and written communication skills
Advanced typing speed (minimum 70 WPM with high accuracy)

Fully remote position
High-speed, stable internet connection
Professional-grade webcam
High-quality speakerphone or headset
Modern computer with reliable performance

Empathetic and active listener
Ability to create a non-threatening, supportive conversation environment
Quick thinking and adaptable communication style
Patient and persistent in building relationships
Skilled at drawing out information from reserved individuals Note: This is an independent contractor position. Candidates must provide their own equipment and manage their own taxes and benefits.

title: Engenheiro de dados sênior
description:
Sobre a Volpi
Somos uma fintech em crescimento acelerado que está protagonizando a evolução do financiamento imobiliário. Transformamos processos tradicionalmente burocráticos, caros e ineficientes em experiências inteligentes, simples e digitais. Se você acredita que tecnologia pode mudar a vida das pessoas - e quer fazer parte de uma equipe que vive isso na prática - vem com a gente!
O desafio
Buscamos um Senior Data Engineer para liderar a construção da engenharia de dados da Volpi desde a base.
Hoje, nossos dados estão distribuídos em múltiplas fontes, com diferentes níveis de maturidade. Seu papel será estruturar essa fundação: definir a arquitetura, organizar os dados, criar pipelines confiáveis e habilitar a criação de produtos de dados que apoiem decisões críticas de negócio.
Aqui, você terá alto nível de autonomia e ownership, tomando decisões técnicas que vão sustentar o crescimento da empresa nos próximos anos.
O que você vai fazer:
Desenhar, implementar e evoluir a arquitetura de dados da Volpi, com foco em um modelo de lakehouse na AWS;
Estruturar pipelines de ingestão, transformação e consumo de dados (batch e, futuramente, streaming);
Trabalhar com dados sensíveis de crédito e pessoas, seguindo padrões rigorosos de segurança, governança e compliance;
Lidar com dados distribuídos em múltiplos silos, conectando fontes e criando visões mais maduras para o negócio;
Atender demandas estratégicas de diferentes áreas (crédito, operações, produto, engenharia);
Organizar e evoluir o data lake existente (já temos estrutura inicial em AWS, Athena e S3);
Criar a base para produtos de dados futuros, incluindo análises avançadas de crédito e soluções orientadas a dados;
Atuar de forma full-cycle, da concepção técnica à implementação, operação e evolução em produção. O que esperamos de você:
Experiência sólida como Data Engineer, com forte mentalidade de engenharia (Data Engineer aqui é dev);
Domínio de Python e SQL para construção de pipelines e soluções de dados em produção;
Experiência prática com AWS, especialmente serviços como S3, Athena e IAM;
Conhecimento e uso de Infraestrutura como Código (Ia C);
Vivência com pipelines de dados em produção, lidando com volumes relevantes e dados sensíveis;
Forte preocupação com segurança da informação, padrões de projeto e boas práticas de engenharia;
Experiência em ambientes de startup, lidando com pouco legado e muita construção do zero;
Autonomia para tomar decisões técnicas e conduzir projetos end-to-end;
Capacidade de traduzir necessidades de negócio em soluções de dados escaláveis;
Comunicação clara e estruturada, especialmente em ambientes assíncronos. Será considerado um diferencial:
Experiência com arquiteturas de dados modernas, como lakehouse;
Uso de ferramentas de orquestração e transformação de dados (ex: Airflow, dbt ou similares);
Atuação em domínios complexos e regulados, como financeiro, crédito ou seguros;
Vivência na construção e estruturação de plataformas ou áreas de dados desde o início. Benefícios que oferecemos:
Modelo remoto prioritário
Plano de saúde Alice (100% pago para titular e dependentes)
R$600/ano para infraestrutura de home office
R$1.000/ano de auxílio educação
30 dias de descanso remunerado + 10 dias de recesso de fim de ano
Day off no aniversário
Total Pass (incluindo Total Mind)
Acesso ao Wework
Encontros presenciais para troca e conexão com a nossa Tribo

title: Senior backend engineer (golang)
description:
This position offers you the opportunity to join a fast-growing technology organization that is redefining productivity paradigms in the software engineering industry. Thanks to our flexible, distributed model of global operation and the high caliber of our experts, we have enjoyed triple digit growth over the past five years, creating amazing career opportunities for our people.
If you want to accelerate your career working with like-minded subject matter experts, solving interesting problems and building the products of tomorrow, this opportunity is for you.
We are seeking a Senior Backend Engineer with strong Go (Golang) expertise and hands-on experience building secure, high-throughput systems in crypto, blockchain, or financial domains.
This role sits at the intersection of distributed systems, cryptography, and regulated financial infrastructure, contributing to mission-critical platforms that process high-value transactions at scale.
The impact you'll make:
Design, implement, and maintain high-availability backend services using Go (Golang).
Build and evolve crypto-native systems, including wallets, custody services, transaction pipelines, and blockchain integrations.
Develop secure APIs and internal services that handle sensitive financial and cryptographic operations.
Collaborate with product and architecture teams to translate requirements into scalable technical solutions.
Optimize systems for performance, reliability, and fault tolerance in distributed environments.
Participate in architecture reviews, code reviews, and production incident resolution.
Ensure compliance with security, auditability, and regulatory requirements typical of financial and crypto platforms.
Contribute to CI/CD pipelines and cloud-native deployment strategies.
Act as a technical advisor within the engagement, supporting best practices and engineering excellence Technology Stack:
Go (Golang)
Blockchain What you'll bring to us:
5+ years of backend engineering experience, with a strong focus on Go.
Prior exposure to crypto, fintech, payments, or financial infrastructure is highly preferred.
Experience working in consulting, staff augmentation, or cross-team delivery models is a plus.
Ability to operate autonomously while collaborating effectively with distributed teams.
Strong communication skills in English, able to explain complex technical topics to mixed audiences.
Pragmatic problem-solver with a delivery-oriented mindset.
Comfortable working in fast-moving environments with evolving requirements.
Ability to balance client needs, technical quality, and delivery timelines.
Desirable experience with Hashing (SHA-256, Keccak), Digital signatures (ECDSA, Ed DSA), Go crypto libraries, Blockchain.
Required to be located in Sao Paulo or Rio de Janeiro. Some of the benefits you'll enjoy working with us:
The chance to work in innovative projects with leading brands, that use the latest technologies that fuel transformation.
The opportunity to be part of an amazing, multicultural community of tech experts.
A flexible and remote working environment.

If you're ready to take the next step in your career in Spain, we'd love to hear from you!

title: Dental insurance posting agent
description:
If you thrive on accuracy, move with urgency, and take pride in making sure every dollar is posted correctly and every discrepancy is resolved, this role was made for you.
As a Dental Insurance Posting Agent, you'll be at the core of our revenue cycle operations. You'll ensure that every insurance payment, adjustment, and denial is posted accurately and reconciled promptly, helping protect the financial health of our organization while supporting a smooth experience for patients and providers. Every payment you apply, every discrepancy you investigate, and every balance you resolve directly impacts cash flow, reporting accuracy, and overall client satisfaction.
About i Core
i Core is a dentist-led healthcare company with more than 15 years of experience supporting dental and healthcare practices nationwide. We combine secure, cloud-based technology with hands-on practice management services to help practices run stronger clinical and administrative operations.
We are more than a software company. i Core Connect partners directly with practices to support revenue cycle management, billing, insurance verification, compliance, analytics, and day-to-day operational workflows. Our approach is built on real-world experience and a deep understanding of how practices actually function.
Behind i Core Connect is a thriving, collaborative team of clinicians, operational experts, technologists, and customer success professionals who work together to help our clients succeed. We're proud to be a leading company built by dentists, for dentists — focused on partnership, accountability, and long-term impact.
Mission: To give dental teams one connected platform that lets them focus on exceptional patient care.
Vision: Building the leading technology-enabled dental management platform through excellence in service, automation, and measurable results.
Core Values: Excellence, Accountability, Client Success, Teamwork, Innovation.
Objectives:
Review, generate, and explain patient statements, invoices, and outstanding balances
Communicate with patients via phone, email, or portal to address billing questions, payment plans, and disputes
Post patient payments accurately (credit cards, checks, EFTs) and reconcile accounts
Verify insurance payments and apply adjustments, co-pays, deductibles, and write-offs as appropriate
Collaborate with insurance billing and posting teams to ensure balances are accurate and up to date
Identify and resolve billing discrepancies or misapplied payments
Set up and monitor patient payment plans in accordance with office policies
Maintain detailed and accurate documentation in the practice management system
Ensure compliance with HIPAA and internal billing procedures
Provide professional, empathetic service to patients, including handling escalated or sensitive billing concerns Competencies:
Prior experience in dental billing, patient accounts, or dental revenue cycle management
Working knowledge of dental insurance plans, EOBs, co-insurance, deductibles, and coordination of benefits
Strong verbal and written communication skills with a customer-service mindset
High attention to detail and accuracy in financial data entry
Ability to manage high call volume and multiple accounts simultaneously
Ability to work independently and prioritize tasks effectively.
Full English proficiency
Proficiency with dental practice management software (e.g., Dentrix, Eaglesoft, Open Dental, or similar)
Ability to pass job-specific assessments Benefits:
Personal:
Be a valued leader, not just a trainer You will be recognized as a core member of our management and administrative team, with a direct impact on how our organization grows and succeeds.
Make a real difference at scale Your work supports more than 15,000 dental offices, and every agent you train helps practices run better every single day.
Work with a mission-driven team You'll collaborate with experienced professionals who care deeply about quality, structure, and doing things the right way.
100% remote – work from home Enjoy the freedom of working from home, avoiding traffic, long commutes, and unnecessary daily stress.
Better work-life balance While many companies are pushing employees back into the office, this role continues to offer a remote environment that supports focus, flexibility, and balance.
Stability and long-term growth Join a well-established organization with over 15 years in business and a clear vision for continued growth.
Professional:
Grow your training and leadership skills Strengthen your ability to train, coach, and develop high-performing teams at scale.
Work with industry leaders in dental Collaborate with experienced leaders and professionals across the dental and revenue cycle management space.
Exposure to cutting-edge dental RCM technology Learn and work with modern dental billing, revenue cycle, and automation tools used across thousands of practices.
Build and lead teams Gain the opportunity to lead training cohorts and support the development of future supervisors and managers.
Expand your industry network Meet and work with new people across the dental industry, growing your professional connections.
Develop enterprise-level experience Be part of an organization that supports over 15,000 dental offices, giving you experience at scale that stands out on your resume.
What you can expect from a career with our team!
Competitive hourly rate
Schedule: 8 hours per day between 8:00 AM and 5:00 PM EST
Commitment: Full-time, 40+ hours per week
Work Setup: Fully remote position You will have opportunities to learn new skills from our team of experienced professionals.
If you're ready to take your career to the next level and gain valuable experience, apply today!

If you love teaching, but dread prepping for lessons and grading, this is the perfect job for you. We provide our teachers with all the lesson materials so all you have to do is show up for class and do what you do best, which is teach!
Whether you're looking for a second stream of income or a full-time job, we've got you covered. You can work as little as 16 hours a month up to as much as 30 hours a week.
What is a typical day for an Online English Teacher at Latin Hire?
You will be scheduled shifts two weeks in advance according to the availability you provide us and we also offer the flexibility of dropping shifts and picking up extra shifts.
If you are busier one week, you can drop some of your shifts and have other teachers help you out or if you want to earn more $$ another week, you can pick up extra shifts and help other teachers out.
When you are on shift, you log on to our platform and teach the lessons provided as well as write short feedback for the students after class. Simple as that!
In short, here are some reasons why you will love working as an Online English Teacher with Latin Hire:
Up to 30 hours of shifts available per week!
You be your own boss and set your own schedule
Work from anywhere (as long as you have good Wi Fi, workspace, computer, webcam, and microphone).
Depending on the number of hours you decide to teach and on your schedule, you can earn up to USD 900+ per month. Minimum Requirements:
Portuguese as a first language.
C1 or C2 Level English Speaker
University degree in English Teaching or related area.
One year of experience in teaching English as a foreign language.
Access to a computer with a reliable, high-speed (at least 2 MB) internet connection.
Must pass a criminal background check.
Teachers must provide at least ten (10) hours of weekly availability. Who we are:
Established in 2003, Latin Hire recruits and manages teams of subject matter experts (SMEs) for online education companies. For over 20 years, our teams have played key roles in the backend of very successful educational startups.
